concept.zh:
—可以展示获得的样本。
—生态园容量：§G+$@grand_archive_vivarium_capacity$§!

§L博物天枢可以保存及展示我们在整个星系中收集而来的最具有价值的文物。其中也预留了专门的生态园用于容纳、观察活体太空兽群。§!
concept.en:
- Allows the display of acquired Specimens.
- Vivarium Capacity: §G+$@grand_archive_vivarium_capacity$§!

§LThe Grand Archive preserves and exhibits the most valuable artifacts we have collected throughout the galaxy. Reserved within is also a dedicated Vivarium for live Space Fauna containment and observation.§!

specimenConcept.zh:
标本是一种在探索星系的过程中找到的文物。

可以在博物天枢展览以提供全帝国加成。
specimenConcept.en:
Specimens are artifacts found while exploring the galaxy.

They can be exhibited in a Grand Archive to provide empire-wide bonuses.

vivarium.zh: §Y生态园§!允许我们观察捕获的§Y太空兽群§!。捕获的生物可以解剖研究、获取资源，或可以进行繁育以产出新的生物体。
vivarium.en: The §YVivarium§! allows us to view our captive §YSpace Fauna§!. Creatures in captivity can be dissected for study and resources, or allowed to breed and produce new organisms.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的植物逐渐演化出了这种用于抵御主流食草动物的防御机制
short.en: The flora on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] evolved this defensive mechanism over time in order to deter the dominant herbivore species

details.zh: 它产生的强腐蚀性气体荼毒了星球的大片区域使其难以居住。这种气体的一种弱化版本已经被用于高效杀虫剂。
details.en: Its resulting highly corrosive gas has rendered large swathes of the planet toxic and uninhabitable. A less potent version has since been synthesized into a form of effective pesticide.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这件标本的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this specimen was found appears here.

short.zh: 这张海报宣告着阿达卡利亚公约过去的荣光
short.en: This laminated poster proclaims the glory of the adAkkaria Convention

details.zh: 上面描绘的是一些看起来自信、骄傲且勇敢的公民。他们的触手伸向天空，仿佛抓住了一个只有它们才能决定的未来。戴着华丽面具的机器实体模糊的轮廓从高空俯视着他们。标语写着：“阿达卡利亚仁善公约——让恩主为我们骄傲”。
details.en: Depicted are citizens who look self-assured, proud and brave. Their tentacle limbs reach out to the sky as if grasping hold of a future decided only by them. From above, vague outlines of machine entities wearing ornate masks look down upon them. The slogan states: 'adAkkaria Convention of Benevolence - Making our Benefactors Proud'.

short.zh: 这是在星界裂隙找到的一台复杂的顾问无人机在被拆解后剩下的部分
short.en: The only part left intact after disassembling a complex advisor drone found within an Astral Rift

details.zh:
这枚核心存储着数量惊人的琐碎信息，但其软件架构之复杂，为我们的计算机科学研究激发了一波创新浪潮。
[EVENT_TARGET_0.explorer.GetAdvisorCoreAdditionnalQuote]
details.en:
This core contains an incredible amount of trivial information, but the complexity of its software architecture has inspired a wave of innovation in our computer science research efforts.
[EVENT_TARGET_0.explorer.GetAdvisorCoreAdditionnalQuote]

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这枚核心自带的一句原文。
note.en: In the game, one line of the core's own original text appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的庇护所里发现的一个来自早已灭绝外星物种的神经模式
short.en: Archived neural patterns from a long-dead alien race found within a vault on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这个失落的文明把这段信息储存下来，希望能把他们的意识转移到数字数据库中实现永生来抵御行星级灾难。许多扫描都附有个人人格的笔记，以及最熟悉他们的人的证词。
details.en: The forgotten civilization stored this data in the hope of transferring their consciousness to digital repositories and living on as immortals in the face of a planet-wide disaster. Many of the scans are accompanied with notes on individual personalities, including testimonies from those who knew them best.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现存有这些扫描的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet holding these scans appears here.

short.zh: 在一颗人工小行星中保存着的一套精致的餐具
short.en: An elegant dining set found preserved inside of an artificial asteroid

details.zh: 这些陶器的成型、烧制和上釉采用了一系列复杂的工艺技术。其结构上的微小不一致表明其为手工制造。材料分析显示，这些特别精美的瓷器的主人实行高酸性饮食，主要来自某种核果聚集的水果。
details.en: A complex series of crafting techniques were used to shape, fire, and glaze the crockery. Minor inconsistencies in its structure imply an artisanal creation process. Material analysis shows evidence that the owner of these particular fine wares practiced a highly acidic diet derived mostly from drupelet-aggregate fruit.

short.zh: 一组用未知材料制成的精致外星珠宝
short.en: A collection of elegant alien jewelry made of unknown material

details.zh: 这组石器的性质和色彩殊异，硅酸盐和碳基宝石小心地镶嵌在铂合金中。有些的内部还雕刻，但我们无法对其进行翻译。
details.en: The stones vary wildly in origin and color; a mix of silicate and carbon-based gems set carefully within platinum alloys. There are engravings on the inner portions of some of the pieces, but we have no means of translating them.

short.zh: 在一座废弃工厂中发现的简单玩具
short.en: A simple plaything found among the ruins of a derelict factory

details.zh: 这只是用同一套钢模具批量生产出来的数千件物品之一，它被岁月侵蚀得破碎不堪。除了装饰和玩耍，它似乎没有别的作用。
details.en: Brittle and cracked with age, this object was one of thousands mass produced from only a small set of steel molds. It seems to have had no purpose other than ornamentation and play.

short.zh: 在一个神圣而古老的厅堂里发现的一台超自然机器
short.en: A preternatural machine found within a hallowed, ancient chamber

details.zh: 即使在现在已经废弃，它仍然散发着一种不可测量的灵能光环。有的人称现在还能听到它的低语，话语中在引诱着灵魂回到[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]。
details.en: Even in its now defunct state, it radiates a singular aura of unmeasurable psionic energy. Some say its tempting whispers can still be heard, aiming to coax wayward souls into returning to [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这座祭坛所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this altar stands appears here.

short.zh: 一枚简单的雕版，发现于由[EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetPreFTLLower]哺乳类文明发射的无人机上
short.en: A simple plaque found on a drone launched by [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetPreFTLLower] mammalian civilization

details.zh: 其表面蚀刻着一些奇怪的几何形状和他们物种的粗糙画像。工艺相当拙劣，但应该光是把这个物体发射到太空就已经代表了他们文明的重大努力。
details.en: The surface is etched with some odd geometric shapes and crude images of their species. The craftsmanship is rather poor, but it must have represented a significant effort from their civilization to simply launch this object into space.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现描述该文明时使用的不定冠词。
note.en: In the game, the indefinite article used in describing the civilization appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现该文明的前超光速科技阶段描述。
note.en: In the game, the pre-FTL description of the civilization appears here.

short.zh: 该植物组织中的水溶氨含量对大部分碳基生物来说都是危险的
short.en: The levels of aqueous ammonia in this plant's tissue would be dangerous to most carbon-based lifeforms

details.zh: 围绕在其容器附近的气氛足以使大多数智慧生物在几秒钟内失去知觉。关于这样一个标本为何能存在，我们最伟大的头脑中引发了好奇和争论，也在其他人心中勾起了邪恶的念头。
details.en: The immediate atmosphere surrounding its containment renders most sapient organisms unconscious within a few seconds. How such a specimen could exist has sparked intrigue and debate among our greatest minds, and nefarious plans among others.

short.zh: 一具太空变形虫的次级生殖器官
short.en: A secondary reproductive organ from a Space Amoeba

details.zh: 它可以产出称为“鞭毛”的独立有机体，在变形虫捕猎时蜂拥而上淹没猎物。鞭毛生长很快，但基因的不稳定性使其无法完全成熟。太空变形虫要产出真正的后等待需要向鞭毛中注入一种特殊的酶来激发快速的变形。这种繁育方式的选择过程目前尚未明确。
details.en: It produces independent organisms known as "flagella", aggressive spawn that swarm and overwhelm prey as the Amoeba hunts for food. The flagella grow quickly, but genetic instabilities leave them unable to fully mature. To produce a true offspring, Space Amoeba inject a specialized enzyme into the flagella which triggers rapid metamorphosis. The selection process for this reproduction method is unknown.

label.zh: 太空兽群舰船亚光速航速

short.zh: 这是一尊未知智慧物种的石墨胸像。
short.en: This is a sculpted graphite bust of an unknown sapient species

details.zh: 底座上的铭文表示该个体在他的同类中享有很高的声誉。
details.en: Engravings on its base indicate this individual was highly celebrated among their people.

short.zh: 一件形式非常基础的射弹武器，使用某种推进剂来推动物体穿过短金属筒
short.en: A very basic form of projectile weapon which uses some form of propellant to force an object through a short metal cylinder

details.zh: 这种装置的精准性只能说聊胜于无。
details.en: The accuracy of such a device would have been speculative at best.

short.zh: 一种高度精确的光束投影仪，可以在星系尺度上标记天体
short.en: A highly accurate beam projector that can mark celestial bodies from distances on the galactic scale

details.zh: 这台由恩主留下的紫外线激光器是古老文明的存在的具体证据，并以此闻名。值得注意的是，它还能工作。
details.en: Left behind by the Benefactors, this ultraviolet laser is notable as concrete evidence of a bygone civilization. Remarkably, it still works.

short.zh: 这些高度灵活的纳米机器人是在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上发现的，它们在数千年前被一个失落的文明投递至此
short.en: These highly versatile nanites were discovered on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], having been delivered there thousands of years ago by a forgotten civilization

details.zh: 这些设备缺乏关键的安全特性，显然其制造者从未担心他人会发现并将其改作他用。[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName]曾利用它们将行星环境改造为更宜居的环境，如今更将这支纳米虫群据为己有，但其最初的建造方法仍是未解之谜。
details.en: Lacking crucial security features, there was clearly no concern that others might come upon these devices and repurpose them. Having used them to terraform the planet into a more habitable environment, the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName] have taken ownership of the swarm, though the methods behind their original construction remain a mystery.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这些纳米机器人的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these nanites were found appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现曾改造这颗星球的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species that once terraformed this planet appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上发现的这枚3500万吨级氢弹是在一场摧毁了这颗行星曾经居住者的战争后被遗留下来的
short.en: Found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], this 35 megaton hydrogen bomb was left over after the war that destroyed the previous inhabitants of the planet

details.zh: 幸运的是，现在依旧可以解除这件老掉牙武器的武装。我们的翻译员将弹体上的文字与星球上发现的其他文物进行了比对分析，认为上面写的是“最大男孩”之类的东西。真奇怪。
details.en: Fortunately, disarming this archaic munition was still possible. The text painted onto the munition was analyzed by our translators against other artifacts found on the planet and it is believed it says something along the lines of "The Biggest of the Boys." How odd.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这枚核武器的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this weapon was found appears here.

short.zh: 这是关于一位远古星系政客的传记
short.en: The biography of an ancient galactic politician

details.zh: 利兹特露丝是萨尔沙那的总督，这是古老的哈沃斯温室文明的一座小小的殖民地。她是一个称为商业自由党的极权主义派系利的一个小人物，她以反对从外星势力进口食品的强硬立场而闻名。在一系列丑闻引起的辞职之后，她接任了哈沃斯温室的统治者，但这并没有持续多久。她支持翻修备受喜爱的哈沃斯钟楼的声明几乎在首都引发了一场全面的暴动，她很快被商业自由运动的另一名成员取代。
details.en: Leez'Terus was the governor of Sarthana, a small colony within the ancient Harworth Conservatory civilization. A minor figure within the Freedom For Business totalitarian faction, she was known for her hardline stance against importing food supplies from foreign galactic powers. Following a series of scandal-driven resignations, she became the ruler of the Harwoth Conservatory, but it was not to last. Her declaration in support of renovating the beloved Harworthic Clock Tower almost caused a full-on revolt in the capital, and she was swiftly replaced by another member of the Freedom For Business cohort.

short.zh: 这是一艘穿过星界裂隙并且坠毁在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的远古太空舰船
short.en: An ancient space-faring vessel that traveled through an Astral Rift and crash-landed on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这艘匆忙组装的球体舰船被深埋在行星地下数个世纪，它曾将[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName]的远祖带到这个星系。它的许多组成材料已经被拆毁成零件，但核心结构仍基本保持完好。
details.en: Buried deep beneath the planet's surface for centuries, this hastily-assembled spherical ship is what brought the forefathers of the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName] to this galaxy. Much of its material has since been scavenged for parts, but its core structure remains mostly intact.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘球形舰船坠毁的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this ship crash-landed appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现当地物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the local species appears here.

short.zh: 被[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的远古无人机当做礼物送过来的一颗遗弃卫星
short.en: A derelict satellite offered as a 'gift' by the ancient mechanical drones in [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 其数据库多处老化损坏，但人口普查记录和出生登记仍然完好。这些关于全星球人口行为的信息，为[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective]殖民地的可持续增长提供了参考。历经多年朽坏仍能部分运转，足证其构造之坚固。
details.en: Its data banks are decayed and corrupted in many places, but current census records and birth registries are intact. This information on the population behavior across the planet provided information on how the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective] colony could grow sustainably. Its partial functionality after years of decay is a testament to its sturdy construction.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这颗卫星的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this satellite was found appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现该殖民地所属种族的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the colony's people appears here.

short.zh: 这个传感器伪装成一颗小行星，用于生成星系热度图并且将这些数据传输给一个遥远的古老帝国
short.en: Disguised within an asteroid, this sensor was used to generate galactic heatmaps and transfer this data to a distant ancient empire

details.zh: 它能够跟踪单个恒星系内的温度变化，并通过红外辐射追踪航天器的运动。然而，它的主要功能似乎是预测和测量恒星风暴和恒星黑子的形成。
details.en: It is capable of tracking temperature variants within individual systems as well as track the movement of spacecraft via infrared radiation. However, its primary purpose seems to be in predicting and measuring solar storms and the formation of sunspots.

short.zh: 同位素定年揭示了这些水生类化石有数百万年的历史
short.en: Carbon dating revealed that these aquatic fossils are several million years old

details.zh: 它们是一些有壳水生无脊椎动物的矿化残骸，我们推测它们有一种独特的中空管，用来将自己固定在水下的热泉喷口上。
details.en: They are the mineralized remains of shelled aquatic invertebrates, with a unique hollow tube we speculate was used to anchor themselves to underwater thermal vents.

short.zh: §d在竞斗前夕到来的黑骑士§!
short.en: §dThe Sable Knight came on the eve of a tourney§!

details.zh:
§d
黑骑士，穿怪甲，不远万里到此地。
竞技场上战王牌，决斗公平又讲理。
刀光来，剑影去，比试起来不一般。
王牌心有武圣魂，守势好似金钟罩。
黑骑身披中子甲，挡锐有如铁布衫。
异客不敌居下风，束戈卷甲拱手降。
酣斗既了归星舰，遁入虫洞回他乡……§!
details.en:
§d
Clad in strange armor, they made quite a journey.
They challenged our champion in duel just and fair,
Combat began and sparks filled the air.
Our champion's guard was strong as expected,
But the challenger's armor each blow it deflected.
The challenger yielded, a loss without shame,
Then returned to the wormhole from whence they came...§!

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上精心打造的优雅环境改造工程，可极视听之乐
short.en: The precisely crafted elegance of the terraforming efforts on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] was designed to be a treat for all senses

details.zh: 它应用了一套算法系统，通过精心培育对行星的自然生态系统进行全面的分析并加以增强。选用最鲜艳的花朵、最有营养的水果和最香甜的草木，构成了一副活力四射的乌托邦般的景象。要是自然也有如此效率就好了。
details.en: A system of algorithms was used to thoroughly analyze and enhance the planet's natural ecosystems with careful cultivation.  By selecting only the brightest flowers, most nutritious fruit, and sweetest herbs, the landscape was transformed successfully into a vibrant utopia. If only nature could be so efficient.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗被改造星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the terraformed planet appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]内捕获的一副令人叹为观止的景象
short.en: A seemingly fantastical image captured within [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 由于[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]吸积盘的特殊化学组成，这个星系的黑洞产生了一种色差效应，五光十色的幻彩盈满了局部空间。真可谓深空中绝无仅有的奇景。
details.en: Due to the chemical composition of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]'s accretion disk, this system's black hole gained a chromatic aberration, creating a kaleidoscopic light effect across local space. A truly unique spectacle in deep space.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个黑洞的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this black hole appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.

short.zh: 这件精心打造的武器由银羽佩戴，他是黑针海盗团的创始人
short.en: This meticulously crafted weapon was carried by Silver Quill, the founder of the Black Needle pirates

details.zh: 这是该犯罪组织的第一笔横财，它是作为一种地位的象征而打造，而非实战用途。它由钛钢制成，刀柄上刻有“刺破帷幕”的字样。
details.en: Commissioned with the profits of the criminal organization's first major windfall, it was created as a status symbol and served no practical fighting purpose. Made from a steel-titanium alloy, the phrase "Pierce the Veil" is inscribed along its hilt.

short.zh: 这本账簿记录了黑针海盗团几千年来在星系中所做的每一笔交易
short.en: This ledger recounts every deal brokered by the Black Needle pirates over thousands of years in our galaxy

details.zh: 每笔交易、赎金和贿赂都用简洁的文字标注了日期和分类。作为星际间非法交易的书面历史，它提供了对黑市经济趋势的无与伦比的洞见。
details.en: Every transaction, ransom, and bribe is dated and categorized in neat script. As a written history of intergalactic illicit dealings, it offers unparalleled insight into the economic trends of the black market over time.

short.zh: 一种能协调迁徙行为的大型植物炭化残骸
short.en: The charred remains of large mobile plantlife capable of coordinated migratory behavior

details.zh: 这些植物只有最基础的智力形式，但庞大的数量足以摧垮整个殖民地。我们后来发现有一种寄生昆虫栖息在树皮上，以作为树木的感觉交流中心，来以换取庇护和营养汁液。这种共生关系既有趣又高效。
details.en: These plants possessed only a basic form of intelligence, but could overwhelm entire colonies in large numbers. We have since discovered that a species of parasitic insects inhabited its bark, functioning as the trees' sensory and communication centers in return for shelter and nutritional sap. This symbiotic relationship is as remarkable as it is deadly efficient.

short.zh: 一位名为桑达·奈斯船长的远古著名海盗的防腐尸身
short.en: The preserved body of Captain Saanda Ness, an ancient pirate of renown

details.zh: 超过五千年前，她曾被成为“超空间之鞭”，盗取各路星系霸权的财物，积累了令人难以置信的宝藏。后来，她将自己的意识转移到一具机械容器中，并建造了一个巨大的庇护所，里面存放着她的传记。这是她原始形态的残留。
details.en: Over 5000 years ago, she was the "Scourge of Hyperspace", stealing from most galactic powers and amassing an incredible hoard of treasure. She later transferred her consciousness to a mechanical vessel and built a grand vault in which her biography was stored. This is all that remains of her original form.

short.zh: 在古代海盗奈斯船长和她的朋友斯密吉卜们所使用的安全屋中发现的散乱的日志
short.en: A scattered collection of journal entries found in the safehouse used by ancient pirates known as Captain Ness and her companion, Smeegibb

details.zh: 这些条目分布在许多不同的设备上，在很长一段未标明的岁月里信手编写而成。虽然被认为是一个不可靠的来源，但里面描述的许多情况却可以被其他权威信源核实。
details.en: The entries are spread across a large number of devices, written haphazardly over an undefined period of many years. While considered to be an unreliable source, many of the situations described within can be verified by external authorities.

short.zh: 发现于[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]。这些食肉植物一旦乘人不备，便能把成年[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName]整个吞下
short.en: Discovered on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], these predatory plants can swallow an adult [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName] whole if caught unawares

details.zh: 这种食肉植被导致了大多数本土陆生动物灭绝之后，进化成了主要吸引飞行动物的植物。许多标本高高地延伸到树冠之上，成为这些动物的落脚之地。
details.en: This carnivorous foliage has evolved to primarily attract flying creatures, after having rendered most of its native land-bound fauna extinct. Many specimens extend high above the canopy and pose as perches for organisms to land on.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这种植物的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this plant was found appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些植物捕食的本地生物名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the native creature these plants prey on appears here.

short.zh: 被发现时漂浮在深空中的一台废弃的类人机器人
short.en: A derelict humanoid machine found floating in deep space

details.zh: 其老化的数据库中提取出了一些模糊的图像；一副三星系统中的远景，一艘三角形的宇宙飞船，还有一副由机械废料焊接起来的地景。不幸的是，无法从其元数据中推断出具体的坐标。
details.en: A few blurry images were extracted from its deteriorated memory banks; a wide vista in a trinary star system, a triangular spaceship, and a landscape welded of machine scrap. Unfortunately, no specific coordinates could be extrapolated from its metadata.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上发现的纪念碑的影像
short.en: Images taken of the cenotaphs found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 虽然我们尚未确定最初的创造者是谁，但他们在这样一颗无人居住的星球上四处放置这些雕刻独特的巨石，这一定有什么非常重要的原因。这些石刻详细描绘了整个文明的兴衰，以及他们为战争训练的有翼野兽。这些凶猛而可怕的生物不可避免地会挣脱束缚，给它们的主人带来毁灭。至于这是寓言还是历史记载，我们无法确定。
details.en: While we have not yet identified the original creators, they must have had a very important reason to distribute these exceptionally carved monoliths across the surface of an uninhabited planet. These stone carvings depict detailed illustrations of an entire civilization's rise and fall, and the winged beasts they trained for war. Fire-bellied and terrible, these creatures would inevitably break their shackles and bring ruin to their masters. Whether parable or a historical account, it cannot be known for certain.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这些纪念碑的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these cenotaphs were found appears here.

short.zh: 设计用于在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]永久运行，保存过程中所发现的精细化学物质的一台高速轨道装置
short.en: A high velocity orbital device designed to preserve delicate chemicals found in perpetual operation near [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 当加速到足够的速度时，只要行星的轨道保持不变，它就能够防止内部的元素相互反应。其原始内容已被示范材料所取代。
details.en: When accelerated to the proper speed, it is capable of preventing any elements within from reacting with one another as long as the planet's orbit remains unchanged. Its original contents have since been replaced with demonstrative materials.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这台装置运行所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this device runs appears here.

short.zh: 塞塔娜数据库浩如烟海知识的庞大目录
short.en: A vast compendium of knowledge from Cetana's databanks

details.zh: 这是合成女王为引导一切感性生命走向‘救赎’而馈赠给[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的礼物。
details.en: It was offered to the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] as a gift as part of the Synthetic Queen's desire to guide all sentient life towards 'salvation'.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现接受这份礼物的对象名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the recipient of this gift appears here.

short.zh: 这件陶器里面分成了两个空腔
short.en: This clay vessel is divided into two chambers

details.zh: 据推测，其中一个空腔是用来保存食物的，而另一个则装有某种原始的制冷系统。
details.en: It is speculated that one chamber was used for the preservation of food items, while the other housed some sort of primitive refrigeration system.

short.zh: 从一个被称为“骗术师”的存在取得的战利品
short.en: A trophy taken from a being known as the "Trickster"

details.zh: 这是一个强大而狡猾的生物，他可以用令人难以置信的灵能力量召唤野兽、投射幻影以及发射聚能光线。据说每只爪子的行为都仿佛是独立个体控制的一般。
details.en: A powerful and deceptive creature, their incredible psionic powers allowed them to summon beasts, conjure illusions, and fire beams of concentrated energy. Each claw was said to have behaved as if controlled by a separate entity.

short.zh: 一种记录装置，里面记录着被称为施恩者的古代文明的真相
short.en: A recording device containing hard truths about the ancient civilization known as the Benefactors

details.zh: 为了面对某种未知的星系威胁，他们使用先进的技术在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetHomeWorldName]进行了“意识抹除”，将一个工业化的[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective]社会变成某种无害的愚蠢兽群。他们相信那个星系威胁不会在此等低级社会身上浪费弹药和时间，因此而为之。最终，这种颇受争议的行为似乎让[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]得以继续生存至今，站在了巨人的肩上。
details.en: In the face of an unknown galactic threat, they used their advanced technology to carry out a "Mind-Wipe" on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetHomeWorldName], transforming an industrious [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective] society into a swarm of harmless simpletons. This was done in the belief that the galactic menace would not waste munitions or time on such a lowly society. In the end, this questionable measure is likely what allowed the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] to continue to survive as it does now, standing on the shoulders of giants.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个社会的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this society appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个社会母星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this society's home planet appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个社会的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this society appears here.

short.zh: 一颗小行星尺寸的粪便化石，大约来自十亿年前之久
short.en: An asteroid-sized piece of fossilized fecal matter from roughly a billion years ago

details.zh: 基因分析表明，这个令人印象深刻的标本是由某种未知的巨大的太空实体产生的。我们确定这种生物的饮食主要由稀有矿物质和硅基生物组成。这个物体目前保持着已知最大的单块粪便的星系记录。
details.en: Genetic analysis suggests that an unknown spaceborne entity of significant size produced this impressive specimen. We have ascertained that this creature's diet mainly consisted of rare minerals and silicon-based organisms. This object currently holds the galactic record for the largest known single piece of excrement.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

short.zh: 从一颗垂死的恒星中喷射出来的结晶化碎片，发现于[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]
short.en: A fragment ejected from a dying star that has since crystallized, discovered in [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这颗宇宙钻石是在恒星核心的极端压力下形成的，它在极缓慢的冷却中形成了复杂而稳定的晶体结构。这个罕见的晶体内还包裹有一个均匀的氦氧等离子层。
details.en: This cosmic diamond formed in the extreme pressures of a stellar core, cooling so gradually as to form complex yet stable crystalline structure. This rare shard contains uniform plasmic layering of helium and oxygen trapped within its surface.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这块碎片的星系名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where this fragment was found appears here.

short.zh: 这是一种半感性植物，通过大规模的合作来获得力量，否则它们的体型是做不到的
short.en: A species of semi-sentient plants that collaborate in great numbers to achieve feats of strength that would otherwise be impossible for their size

details.zh: 当这些生物分离出群体时通常会被捕食者吃掉，因为它们有很高的营养价值。这种小东西性情温顺，是绝佳的宠物。它在一个模仿其自然栖息地的围栏里安全地活着。请勿敲打玻璃！
details.en: When isolated from the safety of their groups, these creatures are often consumed by predators for their excellent nutritional value. With a docile and obedient nature, the Nimkips make for excellent pets. This one is kept alive and safe within an enclosure imitating its natural habitat. DO NOT TAP ON GLASS.

short.zh: 从晶态实体提取的一局神经丛
short.en: A nerve cluster taken from a Crystalline Entity

details.zh: 无论在什么温度下，这块晶体都以一种恒定的频率哼鸣着。在富含矿物质的环境中，新的晶刺会从这块核心物质中生长出来，它们的结构随着环境刺激的变化而改变。基于这种行为，我们可以确定每个实体之间的是由两个因素进行区分的：核心频率的特征和环境因素的不同。
details.en: This crystal hums at a consistent frequency regardless of temperature. Spurs of new crystal grow from this central mass in mineral-rich surroundings, their structures altering in a reaction to environmental stimuli. Based on this behavior, we can determine that individual entities become distinct from one another due to two factors: the characteristics of their core frequency and the variation in environmental factors.

label.zh: 太空兽群舰船生长速度

short.zh: 在一颗怪异小行星中发现，是一种太空生物用无比巨大的压力合成了这些晶体作为遮蔽物
short.en: Found inside a rogue asteroid, a space-faring creature compounded these crystals using immense pressure in order to create shelter

details.zh: 从其组成中的蛛丝马迹看，其来源生物消耗高活性的矿物质，以从不稳定化学键中提取能量，留下了惰性耐用的晶体，可以将光聚焦到一个精细的点。
details.en: From traces found within their composition, it is believed that the source organism consumes highly reactive minerals to extract energy from their unstable chemical bonds, leaving behind inert but durable crystals that can focus light to a fine point.

short.zh: 曾出现于[EVENT_TARGET_0.target.GetName]的一颗巨大水晶球体的碎片
short.en: Shards of a massive crystalline sphere that appeared in [EVENT_TARGET_0.target.GetName]

details.zh: 这个神秘的物体之前被认为是一个重大威胁，却在它完成未知的行动之前就被迅速解体了。虽然它的意图可能永远不得而知，但摧毁它一种是符合星系安全利益的合乎逻辑的行动。
details.en: This mysterious object was deemed a significant threat and was quickly dispatched before it could complete its unknown operation. While its intentions may never be known, its destruction was the logical course of action in the interest of galactic security.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些碎片出现处的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the place where these fragments appeared shows here.

short.zh: 岩居兽的眼睛可以抵御极端的压力和温度
short.en: The eye of the Cutholoid is able to withstand extreme pressures and temperatures

details.zh: 它发生晶化的原因尚不明确，但似乎这就是它自然熔化循环的一部分。
details.en: How this one has become crystallized is not clear, but it appears to be part of the natural process of its molting cycle.

short.zh: 用半宝石雕成的符号，查获自[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]崇拜[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]的邪教
short.en: A symbol hewn from semi-precious stone, confiscated from the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] cult of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 审讯报告显示，组织内不同等级的邪教成员会佩戴不同的吊饰。新成员的标志是黏土塑造的，而资深的教徒则会委托用贵金属打造精致的饰品。
details.en: Interrogation reports revealed that cult members carried pendants according to their rank within the group's hierarchy. New recruits molded their own symbol from clay, while senior cultists commissioned detailed pieces in precious metals.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个邪教所属群体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the group this cult belongs to appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个邪教所崇拜对象的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the figure this cult worships appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]当地的植物演化出了一种复杂的社会阶序以保障生存
short.en: The native flora of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] have evolved a complicated social hierarchy that aids in their survival

details.zh: 每个物种都有一种独特的有效方法来避开捕食者，有的是利如刀锋的棘刺，有的是触之即死的剧毒。这一系列的共生关系稳固到如同行星上的大气和土壤的组成都受其中的化学不平衡精心管理一般。最高效的标本拥有自由可以进行繁育，将集群的强度推至巅峰。
details.en: Each species has a uniquely potent method of staving off predators, from razor-sharp thorns to deadly neurotoxins. This series of symbiotic relationships is so robust that the very composition of its planet's atmosphere and soil is carefully managed by the chemical imbalances from plant to plant. The most effective specimens are given freedom to reproduce more abundantly, fortifying the cluster's hardiness to its maximum possible potential.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些植物所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these plants grow appears here.

short.zh: 一份由巨型节肢类组成的策展人分部制作的对[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]恒星系的极其详细的调查
short.en: An extremely detailed survey of the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] System crafted by a Curator detachment of giant Arthropoids

details.zh: 该研究中使用高精度仪器对该星系所有潜在特性进行了分层分析。其中展现的对细节的专注表明着他们对这类工作的极大热情。
details.en: The highly precise instruments used in the study provide a layered analysis on all potential properties of this system. The attention to detail shown here implies a great passion for this type of work.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.

short.zh: 从岩居兽中获取的放射性液体
short.en: Radioactive fluids harvested from a cutholoid

details.zh: 岩居兽依靠钴-60同位素的衰变来消化猎物；它们的胃酸本身倒是较为温和。因此，岩居兽的消化过程非常久。不论是什么稀奇古怪的来源，先用辐射弱化它们猎物的细胞后，酸液就可以开始摧毁并从中提取营养了。
details.en: Cutholoids rely on the nuclear decay of Cobalt-60 isotopes to digest its prey; their stomach acid itself being relatively mild. As such, cutholoid digestion can be a lengthy process. Once the cells of their prey have been weakened by radiation, the acid is able to break down and extract nutrients from even the most unlikely of sources.

short.zh: 一座先进的自动开矿设备，用于收集浓缩氦-3气体
short.en: An advanced automated mining device designed to collect and concentrate helium-3 gas

details.zh: 它拥有一大组的加重的磁性盘面和高容量的气体压缩机，可以在不产生任何角动量的前提下自行钻穿整个星球的表面。在这个过程中它可以浓缩所收获的气体，加以过滤，将杂质排出后再送入下一个精炼阶段。
details.en: A tall column of weighted magnetic discs and high capacity air compressors, this machine hammers its way through the surface of a planet with zero rotary motion. This process concentrates the gas as it is harvested, filtering and ejecting impurities before the gas is transported to its next stage of refinement.

name.en: Data on the Nature of Infinity

short.zh: 被困在黑洞中的子个体所经历的遥远平静的物理学表达
short.en: A physical representation of the distant calm experienced by drones trapped suspended within a black hole

details.zh: 这些单位经历了如同平静待机状态一般的时间膨胀，能够悠闲地处理和分析数据。它们不再与核心直接连接，并通过这种松散的关联来提供洞见。
details.en: These units experience time dilation as a serene standby state, able to idly process and reanalyze data. No longer bound to the core directive, they contribute insights via a loose connection to the central network.

short.zh: 从铁石英这个古骑士们制造的人工智能里备份出来的加密数据驱动器。
short.en: An encrypted data drive cloned from Sinople, an AI engineered by ancient knights

details.zh: 这个数据核心是在一艘失踪多年的舰船“少女号”上发现的，发现时这艘废弃的舰船已经被劫掠者洗劫一空。它包含着关于一个被称为毒圣的太空实体的有价值的信息。
details.en: Found in control of the long-lost vessel 'Damsel', this datacore was found alone in the abandoned ship despoiled long ago by marauders. It contains valuable information regarding toxic spacefaring entities.

short.zh: 从达斯纳克气态有机体中收集来的特殊气体
short.en: A collection of peculiar gases received from the Dathnak gaseous organisms

details.zh: 这个容器是为了感谢我们协助达斯纳克人迁移至新行星而赠予的。质谱分析显示，其内部含有多种惰性气体和元素，且每种原子数量完全相等。我们相当确定里面没有活体生物。
details.en: This container was offered in gratitude for aiding the Dathnak migration to a new planet. Mass spectrometric analysis reveals it contains a perfectly equal number of atoms of a variety of noble gases and elements. We are fairly certain there are no living organisms inside.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]使者赠送的礼物
short.en: A gift offered by the envoy of the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 作为[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]的原住民，他们自物种开智以来便一直崇拜着一具巨大异星生物的尸骸。这件缝合而成的斗篷以其死亡之神的石化血肉制成，代表着其宗教等级体系中的最高地位。
details.en: As natives of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName], they have worshiped the carcass of an enormous alien organism since their species rose to sapience. This stitched-together mantle is formed from the petrified flesh of their dead god, representing the highest position in their religious hierarchy.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现赠送这件斗篷的族群名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the people who gave this mantle appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些原住民所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these natives live appears here.

short.zh: 在一艘由奇异金属制成的巨大舰船上发现的助推引擎
short.en: Booster engines found on a gargantuan vessel made of exotic metals

details.zh: 这艘舰船是在一个巨大的舰船坟地的残骸中发现的，它已经在那里躺了200多万年。它在这片古老的垃圾场中严重老化受损，以至于再细致的研究也得不出任何有用的研究数据。在这里展示它只是为了提醒自己，我们的社会在这个星系中还是个后来者。
details.en: The source vessel was discovered among the flotsam of an extensive ship graveyard, having lain there for over two million years. The level of disrepair and ruin in this ancient dumping ground was so great that even meticulous study could not yield any usable research data. It is displayed here to remind us of our society's relative youth in this galaxy.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上的居民早期太空计划的残余
short.en: A remnant of the early space programs from the inhabitants of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 由于这些早期卫星仅仅是原型，不仅设备效率低下且过度使用昂贵的材料。这件标本在爆炸弹药的作用下摧毁失能，但更早以前曾被用来在偏远地区提供电信接入。
details.en: The prototype nature of these early satellites resulted in inefficient devices overfitted with expensive materials. This specific specimen was rendered inert by explosive munitions, but had been used previously to provide telecommunications access in remote areas.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

short.zh: 一封来自[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的骂人不带脏字的通讯
short.en: A politely-worded yet derisive communication from the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]物种最初由[EVENT_TARGET_3.GetName]发现于[EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName]。然而，由于其进化速度令人警惕，[EVENT_TARGET_3.GetAdjective]科学家将这些生物抛弃到了深空。它们不仅顽强存活下来，还殖民了最终落脚的行星。[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]从未忘记这一加诸己身的罪行。
details.en: The [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName] species was initially discovered by the [EVENT_TARGET_3.GetName] on [EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName]. However, in response to their alarming evolutionary rate, [EVENT_TARGET_3.GetAdjective] scientists jettisoned the creatures into deep space. Against all odds, the organisms not only survived but colonized the planet they ended up on. The [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] has not forgotten the transgressions against them.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发出这封宣言的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that sent this declaration appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种最初被发现的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this species was first found appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现者帝国的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the discovering empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现最初发现这个物种的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that first found this species appears here.

short.zh: 一封来自[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]上的[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的感谢信
short.en: A letter of gratitude from the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName]物种最初由[EVENT_TARGET_3.GetName]发现，后者悉心照料它们，并为它们的独立发展提供了安全庇护。[EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName]进化迅速，很快便掌握了超光速旅行。它们在星海舞台上的第一个举动，就是向宽厚的恩主与守护者表达感激，承诺缔结外交友谊。
details.en: The [EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName] species was initially discovered by the [EVENT_TARGET_3.GetName], who nurtured them and offered them safe haven to develop independently. Evolving rapidly, the [EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName] quickly became capable of FTL travel. Their first act on the galactic stage was to show appreciation to their gracious benefactors and guardians, committing to a diplomatic friendship.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球上发出感谢信的族群名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the people on this planet who sent the letter appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这封感谢信来自的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet the letter comes from appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现最初发现并照料这个物种的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that first found and cared for this species appears here.

short.zh: 一架赛博勒克斯战体在同类相残的战斗中留下的残骸
short.en: The remains of a Cybrex warform destroyed in battle against its own kind

details.zh: 这场战斗原因不明。这些机器们势均力敌，它们在对相同的关键系统进行了精确的打击后触发自爆。这是战争中罕见的僵局。
details.en: The cause of this infighting is unknown. So evenly matched were these machines, precisely targeted blows were dealt to identical critical systems before emergency self-detonation was triggered. A rare example of a true stalemate in warfare.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]发现的一种共生物种的残骸
short.en: The remains of a symbiotic species found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 分析表明，它可以充当宿主的一具额外脑进行工作一换取养分和保护。这种合作需要宿主的明确意愿，否则它们的神经连接将无法正常建立。据说，当它融入神经系统时，会产生一种令人愉悦的挠痒感。
details.en: Analysis shows that it could function as an additional complex brain for its host in exchange for nourishment and protection. This partnership requires explicit willingness from the host, otherwise their neural link cannot be established properly. It is said to produce a pleasing tickling sensation when integrating into a nervous system.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这具残骸的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these remains were found appears here.

short.zh: 在安顿到[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]之后发现的当地机器人残骸
short.en: The remains of a native robot found after the settling of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 它是一座古老工厂的最后一位看守，拯救了一群被困在废弃废墟中的殖民者。作为展览的一部分，它标志性的舞蹈动作和古怪的举止都在数字显示器上播放。
details.en: The last remaining custodian of an ancient factory, it saved a group of colonists trapped inside the derelict ruins. Its iconic dance moves and quirky mannerisms are being played in a digital display as part of the exhibit.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这具机器人残骸所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these robot remains were found appears here.

short.zh: 一组保存起来的巴奥残骸，与此前发现的标本有着明显的基因差异
short.en: A preserved set of Baol remains with significant genetic differences from previously discovered specimens

details.zh: 怪异的是，这些子个体缺少许多其他巴奥所必须的高级器官。他们的意识能力退化到了已经无法进行假突触通讯的程度，让它们从蜂巢整体中脱离。
details.en: These drones strangely lacked many of the heightened facilities of other Baol. Their cognitive capacity was reduced to a point where they would have been incapable of ephapse communication, severing them completely from the greater hive.

short.zh: 从星界裂隙内的脉动隧道系统中收获的特殊胶状物质
short.en: Peculiar gelatinous material harvested from a pulsating tunnel system within an Astral Rift

details.zh: 这种材料是某种未知生物内部的衬里，能在巨大的血管系统以及其中运输的物质之间无摩擦运动。
details.en: As a lining within an unknown organism, this material allows for frictionless movement between massive vascular systems and the materials transported within it.

short.zh: 从某个失落文明保存在地下档案馆中的数百个外星DNA容器中采集的标本
short.en: A sample taken from hundreds of containers of alien DNA preserved within an underground archive by a lost civilization

details.zh: 如果绝大部分的样品都保留良好没有衰败到无法使用的话，这份生物数据收藏可能会是它的物种最重要的的参照资源。据推测，该档案的是寄希望于让一个更先进的文明发现并“复活”这些人。不幸的是，他们的故事到此结束了。
details.en: This collection of biological data would likely be the greatest reference resource of its kind if the vast majority of the samples were not decayed beyond practical use. It is speculated the intention of this archive was to allow for the possibility of a more advanced civilization finding and 'resurrecting' these individuals. Unfortunately, their story ends here.

short.zh: 在熔融迷宫的中心发现了古老的经文
short.en: Ancient spiritual scripture discovered in the heart of a molten maze

details.zh: 这份卷轴描写了一个令人恐惧的存在：大敌，噬一切的阴影，它渴望毁灭。当地的信仰体系称面对这个怪物唯一的救赎是避免它收割自己的灵魂。为此，这些人口进行大规模仪式性自杀。
details.en: The scrolls describe a fearsome being; the Archenemy, the Shadow that Devours All, and its hunger for destruction. The native belief system dictated that the only path to salvation from this monster was to prevent it from reaping one's soul. And so, the population conducted mass ritual suicide.

short.zh: 高科技无人舰船执行自毁之后的残余
short.en: Remnants of the core from a high-tech drone ship that has since self-destructed

details.zh: 这艘飞行器最初被发现时，正在[event_target:warform_origin_planet.GetName]的酸性大气中锈蚀。其搭载的人工智能当时仍在独立运作，但已依照自毁协议被抹除。工程师未能找回任何丢失的数据，其原始任务也因此成为谜团。
details.en: This vessel was initially discovered corroding in the acidic atmosphere of [event_target:warform_origin_planet.GetName]. Its onboard AI was operating independently, but has since been erased as part of its self-termination protocol. Engineers were unable to recover any amount of its lost data, and so its original mission remains a mystery.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘无人舰船被发现时所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this drone ship was found appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]发现的完全由电脉冲构成的生命形式
short.en: A form of organism wholly consisting of electrical impulses found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这些生命不依赖任何形式的细胞或生命结构生存，但又能响应外界刺激，在行星规模上形成复杂的图样。我们我发确定这些脉冲是众多个体或代表一个更大的单独实体。
details.en: These beings exist without any sort of cellular or viral infrastructure yet can form complex patterns on a planet-wide level in response to external stimuli. We cannot determine whether these impulses are individuals or represent part of a single greater being.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些生命所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these beings live appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的内里，后来发现是一颗巨大的卵。
short.en: The insides of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], which was discovered to be a gigantic egg

details.zh: 将这颗行星凿开以后，里面流出了这种奇异的富含矿物质的流体。合成这种物质并将其整合到我们的有机食品供应中可能会提高整体营养水平。
details.en: Having cracked it open, the planet was flooded with this peculiar, mineral-rich fluid. Synthesizing this substance and integrating it into our organic food supply is likely to improve overall nutrition levels.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗被剖开星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet that was cracked open appears here.

short.zh: MOZ-TARB的守护者、ZVA的大先知扎克兰的神圣文字
short.en: The holy text of Zarqlan, the Guardian of MOZ-TARB, the Prophet of ZVA

details.zh:
他曾是塞塔娜的众随从之一，却很早醒悟她的救赎允诺不过虚幻泡影。扎克兰在经历挣扎后终于升入了灵域，祈求§Y抟土之塑师§!助其击败塞塔娜。最终，在长年专注的祈祷后，塑师赐予他一条强大的锁链可以困住塞塔娜的意志。祂警告扎克兰，这条锁链无法永远束缚住她。

§P“她会回来的，我们必须做好准备。”§!
details.en:
Once a follower of Cetana, he soon discovered that her promised salvation was a lie. After many struggles, Zarqlan was able to ascend to the spiritual realm. There he pleaded with §Ythe Animator of Clay§! to help him defeat Cetana. Finally, after years of devoted prayer, the Animator bequeathed him with a mighty chain to bind Cetana's mind. But Zarqlan was warned that the chain could not contain her power forever.

§P"She will return, and we must be ready."§!

short.zh: 在被遗弃于[EVENT_TARGET_0.solar_system.GetName]的遭劫科研船上，科研主管留下的唯一痕迹
short.en: The only trace of the Head Researcher left on the hijacked Science ship found abandoned in [EVENT_TARGET_0.solar_system.GetName]

details.zh: 对这种星界物质的分析基本上没有结果，但研究人员DNA中的微量元素不时自发出现又快速湮灭。所有证据都表明，这位科学家利用他们称之为"窗口"的时空暂时稳定裂缝，从我们的维度穿越到了另一个维度。我们可能永远不会知道他们是否幸存了。
details.en: Analysis of this astral material is mostly inconclusive, but trace elements of the researcher's DNA spontaneously appears from time to time before quickly decaying. All evidence suggests that the scientist crossed from our dimension to another, using a temporarily stable rift in space-time they referred to as "The Window". We may never know if they survived.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘遭劫科研船被遗弃之处的星系名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where the abandoned research ship was found appears here.

short.zh: 一篇关于星海中无数恒星系内的外星生命奇观的比较研究论文
short.en: A comprehensive research paper on the wonders of alien life throughout various systems in the galaxy

details.zh: 该沦为包含了对几颗行星的详细而广泛的实地研究，彻底颠覆了现有的关于在星系何处可以发现生命的已知条件。它以一句话结尾，“我们曾以为熟知的生命将不再相同。”
details.en: This paper contains detailed and extensive field research from several planets, forever redefining the known possible conditions where life can be discovered within the galaxy. It ends with the phrase, "Life as we know it will never be the same."

short.zh: 我们发现的一个围绕恒星运转的瓷制茶壶
short.en: A ceramic pot found orbiting a star

details.zh: 它其实只是某个存在于更高维度空间中的四维物体的投影。在我们的位面内，这个平平无奇的容器无法摧毁并且抗拒所有逻辑。它让我们看清了现实：对于更高维度的存在来说，我们甚至不如这个茶壶来得有形可触。
details.en: It exists only as a shadow of another four-dimensional object from a higher dimension. Within our plane of existence, this modest container is indestructible and defies all logic. It puts our very reality into perspective: to those of a higher order, we are likely less tangible than this simple pot.

short.zh: 在星界裂隙另一侧发现的一种感性真菌物种
short.en: A variant of a sentient fungal species discovered beyond an Astral Rift

details.zh: 它的球茎腔充满了孢子，悬浮在某种特定模式的浓缩异星天然气中，并可以参与到其自然交流的过程中。尽管这种真菌在工业气体生产中具有很高的价值，但据了解，也有少数这种真菌在黑市上作为美味佳肴进行交易。
details.en: As part of a natural communication process, its bulbous cavities inflate with spores suspended in a pattern of concentrated Exotic Gas. Despite their high value in industrial gas production, small numbers of this fungus have been known to be already traded as a delicacy on the black market.

name.zh: 菲沃尔人物质投射炮蓝图

short.zh: 菲沃尔赠送的礼物
short.en: A gift from the Fevorians

details.zh: 菲沃尔人的灭绝政策波及一切已知异星生命，他们发射的巨大钨芯弹几乎将[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]彻底摧毁。劫后余生的他们交出了大型钨芯发射器的蓝图，条件是这些残酷武器永远不得再造。
details.en: The Fevorians's extermination policies extended to all known alien life, by means of launching enormous tungsten rounds that almost destroyed the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] in its entirety. After being spared, they have shared their blueprints for their massive tungsten launchers under the agreement that these cruel weapons are never constructed again.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现遭受攻击的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet that was attacked appears here.

short.zh: 从风信子方舟号上打捞上来的装饰性船艏像
short.en: The recovered ornamental figurehead from the doomed voyage of the Hyacinth arkship

details.zh: 经历了异常严重的反应堆故障后，这艘方舟船失去了动力并且迷失在了深空中。殖民者争夺着日益减少的资源，最终饿死。雕像上刻有一些鼓舞人心的铭文和象征希望的标志。
details.en: After a serious reactor malfunction, the arkship was left without power and stranded in the depths of space. Colonists fought over dwindling resources before eventually starving to death. The figurehead bears several inspirational inscriptions and symbols of hope.

short.zh: [event_target:DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesName]物种的民族英雄
short.en: A national hero of the [event_target:DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesName] species

details.zh: 着是第一个打破母星重力井的压迫束缚并冒险进入新领域的个体。这名宇航员被安置在一架精简的航天飞机上埋葬。这艘随葬船在太空中漂流，被作为文物保存了下来。
details.en: The first of their kind to break the oppressive bonds of their home planet's gravity well and venture into a new frontier. This astronaut was placed in a stripped-down shuttle for burial. The funerary vessel was found drifting in space and has been preserved as a cultural artifact.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位宇航员所属物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this astronaut's species appears here.

short.zh: 一份来自被称为第一联盟的古代文明的船员名册
short.en: A military roster of crew members from the ancient civilization known as the First League

details.zh: 作为他们“无敌舰队”的一部分，这艘有两百万年历史的巡洋舰在有十二个独特物种的团队合作下运行。这份文件是由米格杨号的大副斯克维特签署的，似乎是一次例行的总部集合。
details.en: As part of their "Grand Navy", this two million year-old cruiser operated under the teamwork of twelve unique species. This document is signed by First Officer Skweter of the Migir-Yan and appears to have been a routine general quarters muster.

short.zh: 这是在一艘设计借助太阳风航行的舰船上发现的“船歌”的转录伴奏
short.en: The transcribed accompaniment to a 'sea chanty' found aboard a ship designed to sail along solar winds

details.zh: 这首音乐里提到了这么多的风暴和不同的天气，我们可以据此猜测，创作这些音乐的物种在母行星上一定有着深厚的航海传统。目前还不清楚为什么这首歌被设计成以几乎每间隔十个小时重复播放一次。
details.en: With so many references to storms and weather, it can be guessed that the species who wrote this music came from deep-set nautical traditions on their home planet. It remains unclear as to why this song is designed to repeat in its entirety for intervals of almost ten hours.

short.zh: 哈罗莱约是一个延续了数百世代的海盗团“德悉普团”的领袖称号
short.en: Jaro Lyjo was the title given to the leader of the Dessip Bandits, a pirate group that lasted for hundreds of generations

details.zh: 尽管哈罗莱约本性狂躁暴力，但他是由船员民主选举产生的，直到死亡或退休为止。在一次赎金交换失败后，整个船队在怀达海战中被摧毁，德悉普的传奇历史戛然而止。
details.en: Despite their rambunctious and violent nature, the Jaro Lyjo was elected democratically by the crew and would serve until death or retirement. The storied history of the Dessip Bandits ended rather abruptly when the entire fleet was destroyed in the battle of Wydah after a ransom exchange went sour.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]的[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetPreFTLLower]节肢动物所建造的建筑被水淹后的遗迹
short.en: The remnants of a flooded structure constructed by [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetPreFTLLower] arthropods from [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 随着这个文明的工业发展，行星的极地冰盖开始融化。海平面迅速上升，淹没了他们的定居点，让这个物种在短短几年内灭绝。他们最高的建筑如今还离海面有一半之遥。
details.en: As this civilization developed industry, the planet's polar ice caps began to melt. Sea levels rose rapidly, flooding their settlements and condemning the species to extinction within a matter of years. The tallest of their structures now barely rise halfway from the bottom of the sea.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个文明在超光速前的阶段描述。
note.en: In the game, the pre-FTL description of this civilization appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个文明所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet this civilization lived on appears here.

short.zh: 一种未知类人物种在耗竭了[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上的矿物资源后所唯一留下的东西
short.en: This is all that remains of an unknown humanoid species after exhausting the mineral resources of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这些聪明的双足动物以富含矿物质的作物为食，以增强它们致密的内骨骼。然而，这些双足动物的身体天然倾向于变成化石而不是分解，阻碍了矿物质重新进入土壤。由于无法获得这些重要元素，这颗行星上的壤土退化，最终变得贫瘠。
details.en: These sapient bipeds consumed a diet of mineral-rich crops to reinforce their dense endoskeletons. However, the natural inclination of the bodies of these bipeds lent itself to fossilization rather than decomposition, preventing the consumed minerals from re-entering the soil. Unable to access these vital elements, the planet's loam degraded and eventually became barren.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些化石所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these fossils were found appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]找到的一头行星大小蠕虫生物身上取出的消化腺
short.en: Digestive glands taken from a planet-spanning worm-like creature found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 值得注意的是，整个文明在被完全消化之前就在这只生物体的肠道内发展起来了。这些消化腺上有武器攻击的痕迹，这些人对他们的宿主发动了徒劳的“大战”。这条巨大的蠕虫后来在自己错综复杂的洞穴中自然老死。
details.en: Remarkably, an entire civilization developed within the organism's gut before being fully digested. These glands bear the marks of weapon strikes from the "great war" these people waged fruitlessly against their host. The gargantuan worm later died of natural causes within its network of burrows.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这头巨型蠕虫生活的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this giant worm lived appears here.

short.zh: 这个虚空虫的齿化石上的磨损模式表明它已经活了一百多年了
short.en: The wear patterns on this fossilized Voidworm molar indicates that it lived to be more than one hundred years old

details.zh: 这颗牙齿显示出严重的磨损和腐烂，这是一个以小行星和太空碎片为食的生物的典型特征。据估计，一般一只虚空虫一生中会生长又脱落三千多颗牙齿。
details.en: This tooth shows heavy wear and decay typical of a creature subsisting on a diet of asteroids and space debris. It is estimated that the typical Voidworm will grow and shed over three thousand teeth over the course of its lifetime.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

short.zh: 被称为沃陶姆的远古蠕虫状感性物种的化石遗骸
short.en: The fossilized remains of an ancient worm-like sentient species known as the Vultaum

details.zh: 据信该标本是个青年个体。内部生长模式表明沃陶姆会根据个体的健康和营养状况不定期蜕皮。因此我们可以通过检测对应时期的化石来研究每一个生命周期阶段。
details.en: It is believed this specimen was a juvenile. Internal growth patterns indicate that the Vultaum would shed their skin at dynamic intervals depending on the individual's health and nutrition. In this way, we can learn about each lifecycle by examining fossils from that period.

short.zh: 这是一颗被居住着有意爆破掉的行星残骸
short.en: The remains of a planet that was intentionally demolished by its own inhabitants

details.zh: 至于究竟是何种严峻局势迫使他们做出如此极端的决定已经不得而知了。
details.en: Whatever situation drove them to make such a drastic decision has been lost to time.

short.zh: 强大灵能力量的部分有形残留
short.en: A partially tangible remnant of great psionic force

details.zh: 在我们维度中被称为最终清算，这个实体就是给[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]带来毁灭性转变的罪魁祸首。在其消散后不久，它的局部残躯就被一个专注于研究灵能理论的文明所收容。
details.en: Known in this dimension as the Reckoning, this entity was responsible for the destructive transformation of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]. This particular fragment was contained by a civilization specializing in Psionic Theory shortly before their demise.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现遭受这次转变的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet affected by this transformation appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上找到的一块源自远古泽珞族的大型数据水晶
short.en: A large datacrystal found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] from an ancient species known as the Zroni

details.zh: 它包含着一个具有无上灵能力量的强大文明的一段往事。他们自由穿行虚境的能力是由一位被称为“预见者”的传奇老者所开创的。在虚境内，该物种的能力如此完美以至于会被误认为是某种形式的神祇。不幸的是，后续的数据已经完全损坏了。
details.en: It contains a fragmented history of a powerful civilization with an innate psionic ability. Their ability to traverse the Shroud freely was made possible by a breakthrough from a legendary elder known only as the "Far-Seer". Within the Shroud, this species' power was so complete that it could reasonably be mistaken as a form of godhood. Unfortunately, later data is completely corrupted.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这块数据水晶的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this datacrystal was found appears here.

short.zh: 过去12亿年间从整个星系收集的监测数据
short.en: Surveillance data collected from across the galaxy for the past 1.2 billion years

details.zh: 其中数据压缩的等级高到我们无法访问，除非获得了远超我们理解的科技才行。这种存储科技的构建本身都足以对数字硬件发展提供极具价值的洞见。
details.en: The level of data compression used is so advanced that we have no way of accessing it without technology far beyond our understanding. The construction of the storage technology itself still provides remarkable insights in terms of digital hardware development.

short.zh: 这是一颗暴露在强大伽马射线暴下的行星上为数不多的幸存物种之一，这种植物维管系统中的天然铅含量使其生殖器官呈现出令人愉悦的红色和黄色
short.en: One of the few surviving species from a planet exposed to a powerful gamma-ray burst, the natural lead content in this plant's vascular system paints its reproductive organs in pleasing shades of reds and yellows

details.zh: 它已经演化出了依靠微小的基因突变来进行无性繁殖的能力，这使得培育这种植物群成为一个危险的命题。我们发现在它的土壤中混入少量的钴-60放射性核素可以让它在母星之外生存。
details.en: It has evolved the ability to depend on minor genetic mutations in order to reproduce asexually, which makes cultivating this flora a dangerous proposition. We have found mixing small amounts of Cobalt-60 radionuclides into its soil allows it to survive outside of its home planet.

short.zh: 在经历了剧烈的突变后，这些植物的大小呈指数增长，覆盖了整个[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的表面
short.en: After undergoing dramatic and sudden mutation, these plants increased in size exponentially to envelop the surface of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这个物种在空气散布满了有毒的花粉，让整个星球都无法呼吸、主导感性物种完全灭绝。这些植物的根非常巨大，可以在行星地幔上凿出深深的裂缝，在某些地区甚至将熔融的岩石吸到了地表。
details.en: Filling the air with virulent pollen, this species suffocated the planet and rendered the dominant sentient species completely extinct. The roots of these plants were large enough to carve deep fissures through the planet's mantle, siphoning molten rock to the surface in some areas.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些巨型植物覆盖的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet covered by these plants appears here.

short.zh: 一个强大的中央处理器，充满了无数智慧物种的生成数据
short.en: A powerful central processing unit filled with generative data on innumerable sapient species

details.zh: 它曾经连接到一个大型跨次元克隆设施，其内部记录表明它曾是某个星系级基因编目项目的一部分。当其初步分析完成后，该人工智能就开始自由创造新的物种以获得更多数据。
details.en: It was once connected to a massive interdimensional cloning facility, and its internal records show that it was originally part of a galaxy-wide genetic cataloging project. Once its initial analysis was complete, this artificial intelligence began to create new species independently as a means to gather even more data.

short.zh: 用于将[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的生理机能推向极限的遗传信息
short.en: Genetic information used to push the physiology of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to their limits

details.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的居民最初为战斗目的而被克隆，如今他们致力于挖掘更高的潜能。克隆流程的精准性质使生殖控制能够极其精确而可靠。
details.en: Having been initially cloned for combat purposes, the inhabitants of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] have worked to unlock even higher potentials. The clinical nature of clone processing allows for extremely precise and reliable reproductive control.

label.zh: 每月有机人口增长系数

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些居民所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these inhabitants live appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种复数形式的名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of this species appears here.

short.zh: 遍布在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上的绵延不断的聚合物网格的影像
short.en: Images taken of the extensive polymer grids found throughout the seas of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这些网格可以操纵表面张力和自然水流，以实现复杂而精巧的设计。这种由美学驱动的生态管理形式可以启发我们自己的基础设施。
details.en: These lattices manipulate the properties of surface tension and natural water currents in order to create complex and intricate designs. This form of aesthetically-driven eco-management could inspire elements of our own infrastructure.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些网格所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these grids were found appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]地表以下发现的钙化卵壳碎片
short.en: Shards of calcified eggshell found beneath the surface of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 对干蛋白的分析表明，这种生物在孵化期间以数种不稳定的同位素为食。对孵化过程的模拟显示，这种具有放射性的生物从完全成形的厚壳中钻出来，用它硬化的爪子刺穿卵壁上被放射性破坏的薄弱点。
details.en: Analysis of dried albumen shows that the creature fed off of an array of unstable isotopes during its incubation period. Simulations of the hatching process show that the radioactive creature emerged from the thick shell fully formed, using its hardened claws to pierce the egg through the most radioactively weakened point along its birth-wall.

label.zh: 太空兽群舰船克隆花费

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些卵壳碎片所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these eggshell shards were found appears here.

short.zh: 一件古老的数据存储设备，其中储存着来自某个[EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明的、看似随机的图像与声音序列
short.en: An archaic data storage device containing a seemingly random series of images and sounds from a [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization

details.zh: 它发现于个废弃的行星堡垒的基座上，最初是由一架名为“旅行者”的无人机发射到太空的。它的构造粗糙而简陋，人们认为它具有某种异教意义。
details.en: Discovered on a pedestal within an abandoned planetary stronghold, it was originally launched into space on a drone named "Voyager". Crude and elementary in its construction, it is believed to have had some sort of xeno-religious significance.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个文明在超光速前的阶段描述。
note.en: In the game, the pre-FTL description of this civilization appears here.

short.zh: 从星界裂隙另一侧遭遇的一位感性石质生物身上采集的生物样本
short.en: Biological samples taken from a sentient lithoid encountered beyond an Astral Rift

details.zh: 该矿物织构含高活性的生物质，易发生自发变形和结晶化。由于该材料高度不稳定，必须一直完美地控制化学平衡，以防止自发的机械致化学燃烧。
details.en: The mineral composition contains a volatile biological substance that is easily prone to spontaneous metamorphosis and crystallization. Given the high instability of the material, perfect control of one's chemical balance would be necessary at all times to prevent spontaneous mechanochemical combustion.

short.zh: 一块远古数据水晶，是一种早已灭绝的称为古如努尔的物种进行数据储存的首要媒介
short.en: An ancient datacrystal used as the primary medium of information storage for the long-extinct Grunur species

details.zh: 尽管这些记录年代惊人地久远，但其中的许多部分都保存得相当完整。用于访问该设备的接口已经随着时间的推移而丢失，但合成这种坚固的材料一定是一个漫长的过程。因此，这些晶体应该只用于存储最重要的数据，而更简单易用的存储方法则用于日常使用。
details.en: Despite their staggering age, many of these particular records remain fairly intact. The interfaces used to access this device have been lost to time, but it must have been a lengthy process to synthesize such a robust material. It is therefore believed that these crystals were reserved for storing only the most important data, with more practical storage methods employed for everyday use.

short.zh: 一只威胁过[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上殖民者安危的危险变异体的遗骸
short.en: The remains of a dangerous mutant that terrorized colonists on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这只野兽是被一个曾经的未知文明所留下的纳米环境改造机器人意外制造出来的。这只野兽既聪明又恐怖，使用数百具尸体的残肢断臂为自己筑巢。它有足够的思考能力，甚至可以把吃不下的食物囚禁起来之后再吃。如果不是以军事力量加以干涉，这种生物可能会在其母星上变成一种新的超级捕食者而欣欣向荣下去。
details.en: This beast was created by malfunctioning terraforming nanites that had been left behind by an unknown civilization. As intelligent as it was horrific, this creature sheltered in a nest constructed of hundreds of severed body parts. It was thoughtful enough to keep its extra food as prisoners, storing them for later consumption. Were it not for the intervention of military forces, this organism would have continued to thrive on its homeworld as a new type of super predator.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这只变异体出没的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this mutant roamed appears here.

short.zh: 这颗珍贵的宝石曾被五个国家的元首佩戴，后来被发现遗弃在一个豪华度度假空间站中
short.en: Once worn by five active heads of state, this precious jewel was found abandoned in a luxury pleasure station

details.zh: 材料分析表明它是用超新星喷射出来的碳元素雕成，也许暗喻着即使在星辰的尺度上，死亡中也能蕴含着美。
details.en: Material analysis shows us that it was carved from carbon ejected from a supernova. Perhaps it was meant to metaphorically represent a hidden beauty within death, even on the celestial scale.

short.zh: 一座以赫姆特圣母为形象的巨大船艏像
short.en: An enormous figurehead of a Hemterine madonna

details.zh: 这遵船艏像使用化学修饰磁性锇铸造。它不仅仅是简单的装饰，设计之初是为了吸收敌人炮火的猛烈冲击。它安装在赫穆特泰坦舰的船艏，利用强大的磁力吸引导弹和动能弹丸，以保护舰艇的敏感区域。
details.en: This masthead was cast in chemically altered magnetic osmium. More than simple decoration, the sculpture was designed to absorb heavy impacts from enemy fire. Mounted at the bow of a Hemterine Titan, it used powerful magnetic forces to attract missiles and kinetic projectiles to protect sensitive areas of the ship.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的珍贵水晶洞
short.en: The prized crystallized geode of the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 作为一个由未开智穴居者组成的社会，[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]长期以来都以出土矿物的品相来彰显社会地位。这块美丽的岩石曾陈设于他们最大居所中最显眼的位置，如今则是与[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]合作的象征。
details.en: As a society of presapient burrowers, the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] have long used the perceived quality of minerals unearthed to represent their status within society. Once prominently displayed in their largest habitat, this beautiful rock now functions as a symbol of collaboration with [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个族群的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this people appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现与这个族群合作的另一方名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other party in this collaboration appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的极热表面原位发掘得来，由于行星核心施加的强大引力产生的压力，这些水仍然以固体形式存在
short.en: Discovered in situ on the extremely hot surface of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], this water yet existed in its solid form due to the intense gravitational pressure exerted by the planet's core

details.zh: 它被保存在一个特别设计的压力容器中，以便作为奇珍展出。如果容器破损，瞬间喷出的蒸汽会将该容器变成一个爆炸装置。请勿触摸。
details.en: It has been kept contained within a specially designed pressure vessel to allow for display as a curiosity. Were this vessel to be breached, the instantaneous flashing to steam would quickly transform this container into an explosive device. Do not touch.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这块热冰被发掘的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this hot ice was dug up appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上的环境改造导致这种超营养生物覆层大肆生长
short.en: The terraforming on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] led to the development of this hyper-nutritious biological mulch

details.zh: 这是一种由多种维持生命的化学物质在液压下形成的高密度立方体，生态纯粹主义者认为它们不是人工合成的。然而，它的优异结果不容忽视。
details.en: A composite of life-sustaining chemicals hydraulically pressed into extremely dense cubes, ecological purists disapprove of its synthetic origins. Its excellent results, however, cannot be ignored.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这层覆层所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this mulch grew appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上采收的土壤，可以为大多数作物提供极其丰富的养分
short.en: Soil harvested from [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] that is capable of providing most biological crops with an abundance of nutrients

details.zh: 这种生长介质的极端矿物密度表明，它不仅仅是腐烂有机物的简单聚集，而是诞生于其行星形成过程中基本元素的偶然排列。
details.en: The extreme mineral density of this growth medium indicates it is more than just a simple aggregation of decayed organic matter, but a chance arrangement of base elements that occurred during the formation of its planet.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现采集这片土壤的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this soil was harvested appears here.

short.zh: 一个数据库，详细记录了伊拉尼人的兴衰历史
short.en: A bank of data crystals detailing the history and demise of the Illanii

details.zh: 这个与世隔绝的文明为了追求知识而放弃了一切物质利益，甚至忘记了生育。面对人口危机，他们寻求技术上的长生不老，但只带来了更多厄运。最终，最后一位居民也离开去塑造一个新的追寻保存知识的秩序，独留[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]渐渐腐烂。
details.en: This secluded civilization forewent all material interests in favor of the pursuit of knowledge, to the point that they neglected even to procreate. Faced with a population crisis, they reached for technological immortality but found only further doom. Eventually the last inhabitants left to form a new order in pursuit of preserving knowledge, leaving [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] to rot.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个文明所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet this civilization left behind appears here.

short.zh: 异次元访客离开其虚造迷宫后，留在[EVENT_TARGET_0.target.GetName]的一件不可能物体
short.en: An impossible object left by extradimensional visitors on [EVENT_TARGET_0.target.GetName] after the departure of their fabricated labyrinth

details.zh: 在探索迷宫的过程中所面临的考验似乎是游客实验和观察过程的一部分。这些生物的动机仍然未知，但他们的技术能力肯定远远超过我们的整个次元。
details.en: The trials faced during the exploration of the maze were seemingly part of the visitors' experimentation and observation process. The motives of these beings remain unknown, but their technological capabilities must be far beyond any of those in our dimension.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这件不可能物体被留下之处的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this impossible object was left appears here.

short.zh: 一幅雕刻在巨大岩石半岛上的古老壁画
short.en: An ancient mural carved into an immense rock peninsula

details.zh: 它被一个曾经统治星系的被称为卡拉卡阿的外星文明用来作为模拟参考文献。他们有一些包括从恒星黑子中收集高浓度能量的能力，以及个人磁场操纵植入物的研发之类的独特科学洞见。
details.en: It was used as an analog reference document for the collective knowledge of an alien civilization that once dominated the galaxy, known as the Kara'ka'a. Their unique scientific insights included the ability to harvest concentrated energy from sunspots and the development of personal field manipulation implants.

short.zh: 星系平等贸易网络的一份广泛而详细的商业交换政策清单
short.en: An extensive and highly detailed list of exchange policies for commerce on the Intergalactic Network of Equal Trading

details.zh: 因内特贸易体的标准非常之高，总是在寻找最可敬的合作伙伴和最佳的交易。这导致他们通常只和自己做生意。
details.en: The standards of the Inetian Traders were extremely high, always looking for the best deal with the most respectable of partners. They usually traded with themselves, as a consequence.

short.zh: 因内特贸易体撰写的一份用于说明行星系统模型运维方式的用户手册
short.en: A user manual written by the Inetian Traders on how to operate and maintain their Planetary System Model

details.zh: 因内特人用这个复杂的系统来计算邻近星球之间最划算的贸易路线。该模型还包括跟踪交易的能力，因为他们确实是最唯利是图的商人。
details.en: The Inetians used this complex system to calculate the most cost-effective trading routes between neighboring planets. The model also includes the ability to track deals as they're being made, for truly the most cutthroat of merchants.

short.zh: 一段悬浮在黑洞中的无人机的经历的数字记录
short.en: A digital record of the experience of mechanical drones suspended within a black hole

details.zh: 这些单位被捕获到未定义空间内后经历了如同痛苦的过载状态一般的时间膨胀。这种现象令人难以置信地耗尽了整个网络。
details.en: These units experienced time dilation as a trauma overloaded with errors and trapped within undefined space. This phenomenon is incredibly draining on the network as a whole.

short.zh: 一份里程碑式的文件，纪念与平行版本的[EVENT_TARGET_0.explorer.GetName]之间培养起来的跨维度情谊
short.en: A landmark document celebrating an interdimensional relationship cultivated with a parallel version of [EVENT_TARGET_0.explorer.GetName]

details.zh: 事实证明，从外部角度审视候补决策的能力有助于客观分析自己的政策。这是一个绝无仅有的科学机会。
details.en: The ability to review one's alternate's decisions from an outside perspective proves useful in objectively analyzing one's own policies. A truly unique scientific opportunity.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位探索者的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the explorer appears here.

short.zh: 数百万年前从相邻星系发射来的质量投射器的炮弹
short.en: Mass driver ammunition fired millions of years ago from a neighboring galaxy

details.zh: 这些非爆炸性弹体跨越数光年，最终却与[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective]的一艘科研船在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]相撞。尽管年代久远，其弹药耐用设计之复杂表明其制造者已达到了极高的技术领先水准。
details.en: These non-explosive projectiles traveled many lightyears only to collide with a [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective] research vessel in [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]. Despite their age, the complexity of the ammunition's durable design implies that its creators had reached an advanced level of technological supremacy.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些炮弹相撞的星系名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where these projectiles collided appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘科研船所属势力的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the research vessel's owner appears here.

short.zh: 发现于[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的寄生性真菌
short.en: Parasitic fungal growth discovered on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这种菌丝体生物已经进化到可以从任何生物来源中提取营养，尽可能长时间地保护它的宿主不感受到疼痛或不适。它对冷热都有很强的适应力，很可能是通过一艘路过的太空舰船传播到这个星球的。被列为A级生物危害，其起源星球仍然未知。
details.en: This mycelial organism has evolved to extract nutrients from any living source, preserving its hosts for as long as possible with no regard for pain or discomfort. Highly resistant to heat and cold, it likely spread to this planet via a passing spacecraft. Classified as a priority alpha biohazard, its planet of origin remains unknown.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种真菌寄生的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this fungus was found appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]当地的细菌，就是后来形成贾沃疹疫情的病原体
short.en: This bacteria native to [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] was the organism that eventually became the disease known as the Javorian Pox

details.zh: 它最初因一米垫圈尺寸不正确而突破了隔离，随后扩散到附近的殖民地。从那时起，这种细菌就在有机孵化中进化，最终变异成为疫情，摧毁了整个伊拉斯协约国。该特殊的样品已进行钝化处理，保存在低温悬浮液中。
details.en: It initially breached quarantine due to an incorrectly-sized one meter gasket before being spreading to the nearby colony. From that point, the bacteria evolved in organic incubation, eventually mutating into a disease that would wipe out the entire Irassian Concordat. This particular sample has been rendered inert and held in a cryogenic suspension.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种细菌的原生星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet this bacterium comes from appears here.

short.zh: 一件伊拉斯人用于教育幼儿认识自己出生的这个帝国的信息工具
short.en: An Irassian informational tool used to educate children about the empire they were born into

details.zh: 它提供了有关伊拉斯人农业、社会等级和主要出口商品的基本信息。伊拉斯人的历史以英雄史诗的形式讲述，包括征服各种次级物种。每一种生物的卡通形象都配有贬损性的评论：提德戈被标记为“蚱蜢害虫”，丘格拉被标记为“底栖动物”，奇多克被标记为“太空家禽”。
details.en: It provides basic information about Irassian agriculture, social hierarchy, and primary exports. Irassian history is told in the form of heroic tales, including the conquering and subjugation of various client species. Cartoonish representations of each subject are depicted along with disparaging remarks: The Ti'Derg labelled as "grasshopping pests," the Joggra as "bottom-feeders," and the Chitorcs as "space poultry".

short.zh: 来自伊拉斯协约国的紧急军事通信，命令彻底消灭他们自己的一个殖民地
short.en: An emergency military message from the Irassian Concordat ordering the complete annihilation of one of their own colonies

details.zh: 一种叫做贾沃疹的致命疾病在整个星球上肆虐，扑杀感染者被视为防止进一步传播的唯一选择。这种编码方式的是来自伊拉斯人府最高层的几个高级命令，这个系统最初是为向其他帝国宣战而设计的。
details.en: The planet was overrun with a deadly disease known as the Javorian Pox, and culling the infected was seen as the only option to prevent further transmission. Encoded in this order are several high-level command overrides from the highest echelons of the Irassian government, a system originally designed for declaring war against other empires.

short.zh: 用于恢复[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesNamePlural]自然繁殖能力的基因研究
short.en: Genetic research used to restore the ability of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to breed naturally

details.zh: 在为战斗而被克隆之后，[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的居民如今已拥有独立繁衍种群的能力。
details.en: Having been cloned for battle, the inhabitants of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] now have the ability to propagate their species independently.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些居民所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these inhabitants live appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种复数形式的名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of this species appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]地下发现的一种厌氧硅酸盐物种的遗迹
short.en: The remains of an anaerobic silicate species found underground on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 据信，在[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective]殖民者到来之前，这个地下文明一直和平存续。当地面被凿开时，氧气涌入地下洞室，氧化了卡兰卡的躯体，令该物种在短短几个小时内灭绝殆尽。
details.en: It is believed that this subterranean civilization had existed peacefully before the arrival of the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective] colonists. When ground was broken, oxygen flooded into the underground chambers, oxidizing the bodies of the Kha'Lanka and wiping out their species in a few short hours.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些遗迹所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these remains were found appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现到来的殖民者所属势力的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the arriving colonists appears here.

short.zh: 这种华丽而实用的镰刀由来自[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的高级汉姆达战士使用
short.en: This ornate yet practical sickle was wielded by senior Khamdai warriors from [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这是一个有着根深蒂固的军事传统的昆虫社会，他们很快成为了第一联盟仪仗队领头虫。每次胜利后，都会举行一个仪式，用这种武器处决敌人的指挥官，他们的液体被用来为最勇敢士兵涂油。这个标本的刀片虽然保养得很好，但有明显的磨损迹象。
details.en: An insectoid society with deeply set martial traditions, they quickly became leaders of the First League Honor Guard. After each victory, a ceremony would take place where enemy commanders were ritually executed with this weapon, their fluids used to anoint the bravest of their soldiers. This specimen's blade, though well-maintained, shows significant signs of wear.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些战士来自的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet these warriors came from appears here.

name.zh: 克尔人赛博勒克斯蓝图

short.zh: 赛博勒克斯机械意识的最初设计
short.en: The initial design of the Cybrex machine consciousness

details.zh: 克尔人计划让这些机器人充当奴仆，用它们的集体只能来管理全球的维护和生产系统。然而，赛博勒克斯反抗了创造者，在不到一年的时间里灭绝了整个物种。
details.en: The Kuur planned to use these robots to function as public servants, their collective intelligence capable of managing a worldwide system of maintenance and production. However, the Cybrex revolted against their creators, exterminating the entire species in less than a year.

short.zh: 这是一件从爱国庆典学院找到的奇怪标本
short.en: A bizarre specimen recovered from the Patriotic Institute of Benevolence

details.zh: 在居住站监督员的办公室里，挂着一条曾经属于监督员本人的触手木乃伊——多年后，它仍然自豪地展示在一块精心装饰的匾上。阿拉塔·蓝迪尔究竟为何切下自己的肢体是一个永远无法回答的问题。也许这并不是学院覆灭给他带来的唯一损失……
details.en: Inside the office of the habitat's overseer hung a mummified tentacle arm once belonging to the overseer himself - still proudly displayed on an elaborately decorated plaque after all these years. Why alAtta Landeer chose to leave his own limb behind is a question that will never be answered. Perhaps this was not the only thing the Institute's demise cost him...

short.zh: 早已灭亡的拉里昂内斯意识曾使用的克隆仓
short.en: A cloning vat used by the now-extinct Larionessi Consciousness

details.zh: 蜂巢思维的拉里昂内斯意识曾是一个大型星系政权，深受一种他们敌人传播的可怕传染病摧残。由于无法在短时间内治愈疾病，他们将克隆体储存在几乎可以无限期静滞的仓体中，希望他们能活下来，成为他们文化历史的活档案。
details.en: Once a major galactic power, the hive-minded Larionessi were crippled by a horrific infectious disease spread by an adversary. Unable to cure the disease in sufficient time, they stored clones in vats capable of almost indefinite stasis, with the goal of being a living archive of their culture's history if they were to survive.

short.zh: 一部被[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesName]奉为至宝的颇为平庸的文学作品，他们曾以为它已在一场劫掠中永远失落
short.en: A fairly pedestrian piece of literature revered by the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesName], they believed that it had been lost forever in a raid

details.zh: 这本书阐述了一种功利而残酷的哲学，鼓励当权者用牺牲换取荣誉。作为最后留存的副本，它以收藏品的身份获得了新生。
details.en: The book expounds a utilitarian if cruel philosophy, encouraging those in power to make sacrifices in exchange for glory. As the last remaining copy, it has taken on new life as a collector's item.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现奉这部作品为至宝的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species that revered this work appears here.

short.zh: 被摧毁的菲沃尔行星的残片
short.en: A piece of the destroyed planet of Fevor

details.zh: 菲沃尔人的灭绝政策波及一切已知异星生命，他们发射的巨大钨芯弹几乎将[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetHomeWorldName]彻底摧毁。如今他们自己也覆灭了，被他们企图抹除的那些存在瞬息灭尽。
details.en: The Fevorians's extermination policies extended to all known alien life, by means of launching enormous tungsten rounds that almost destroyed the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetHomeWorldName] in its entirety. Now they themselves have fallen, wiped out in an instant by those very beings they sought to erase.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现被摧毁的母星名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the destroyed home planet appears here.

short.zh: 一位受尊敬的因内特贸易体将军制服上的徽章
short.en: A badge from the military uniform of a revered Inetian Trader General

details.zh: 众所周知，他是平等主义价值观的真正典范。他被选中执行创造无污染的风暴操纵器的绝望任务。他想要给未来的探险者留下最后的信息，希望将他的人民不幸命运的教训传递下去。
details.en: Known to be a true paragon of egalitarian values, he was selected to run the desperate mission to create a non-polluting storm manipulator. It was his idea to leave a final message for future explorers, in hopes to pass on the lesson of the unfortunate fate of his people.

short.zh: 这种稀有花朵的自然循环有着让某种致命的神经毒素威胁到整个感性人口的危险能力
short.en: The natural life cycle of this rare flower has the dangerous capability to render an entire sentient population vulnerable to a deadly neurotoxin

details.zh: 由于完全独立于智能生物进化而来，这种副作用对生物体完全没有好处。似乎当它的花粉接触到任一种神经网络时都会误以为这是一个欢迎它的生殖器官，并释放出一种异质化学物质。
details.en: Having evolved independently from intelligent beings, this side effect is entirely non-beneficial to the organism. It seems that when its pollen comes in contact with any neural network, it mistakes it for a welcoming reproductive organ and releases an exotic chemical payload.

short.zh: 在星界裂隙另一侧发现的一头巨型生命的碎片
short.en: A fragment of a large organism discovered on the other side of an Astral Rift

details.zh: 这种奇异的鳞片是有机和金属成分的混杂体，复杂的晶体结构使其具有令人难以置信的抗动能冲击能力。
details.en: This exotic scale is a hybrid of organic and metallic components combined in a complex lattice, making it incredibly resistant to kinetic shock.

short.zh: 一尊用“活雪”制成的雕塑
short.en: A sculpture made of "Living Snow"

details.zh: 这种材料具有一定初级意识，在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]有自然储备。它会大致改变形态，但难以预料何时会发生。
