details.en: Possessing some form of primitive consciousness, this material has been granted a natural reserve on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]. It routinely changes form, though when this occurs can be unpredictable.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种材料的储存星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this material is stored appears here.

short.zh: 从[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]大气层拍摄的视频中捕捉到的一系列闪烁的颜色
short.en: A series of scintillating colors captured in video from the atmosphere of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这种色彩变化的模式以可预测的频率重复，代表着某种远远超出其美感的东西。它们的恒久存在为这个因战争和破坏而失落的星球增添了一抹辛酸的色调。
details.en: The patterns of colors and movements repeat in predictable frequencies, representing something far beyond their aesthetic beauty. Their ever-present nature adds a poignant tone to the planet lost to war and destruction below.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现拍摄这些极光的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these lights were filmed appears here.

short.zh: 这些字条由[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]从数年之后寄来，为该往何处委派科学家以及该推进哪些研究提供了精确指引
short.en: These notes were sent by [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] from years in the future, providing pinpoint guidance on where to assign scientists and which research efforts to pursue

details.zh: 想掌握这些先验知识的主要代价是要负责将其发挥过去，但干扰时间的进程总是一种冒险的尝试。这条信息的原作者是非常不负责任的，他们制造了这样一个悖论。
details.en: The burden of sending these notes back in time is the primary cost of this advanced knowledge, but interfering with the course of time is always a risky endeavor. The original writers of this message were highly irresponsible for creating such a paradox.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现寄来这些字条的未来身份名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the future sender of these notes appears here.

short.zh: 疯狂掮客是行商中的传奇商人，能够用离谱的要求和丰富多彩的威胁来影响客户
short.en: The Lunatic Broker was a legendary trader among the Caravaneers, able to influence clients with outrageous requests and colorful threats

details.zh: 然而，他的暴力和不可预测的行为迫使顾客想出了某种让他冷静下来的方法。其中一种策略是声音疗法；类似这样的箱子散落在绰尔的罗盘周围，当疯狂掮客的压力水平升高时就会播放安抚的旋律。这件机械装置的每一个部件都是由一位机械大师定制的。
details.en: However, their violent and unpredictable demeanor led to their subjects developing methods to calm them down. One such tactic was sound therapy; boxes such as this one were scattered around Chor's Compass and would play a pacifying melody when the Broker's stress levels were elevated. Every piece of this mechanism was custom made by a master machinist.

short.zh: 宣泄派运动的一篇挑衅性作品
short.en: A provocative oeuvre from the Manifesti movement

details.zh: 其用意是在与社会地位更高者的关系中挑战对自己的认知。它鼓励读者操纵自己的形象，以及创造出流行政治人物的扭曲拼贴画。宣泄派作为一个反文化艺术团体，试图挑战他们认为的压迫体制。这篇文章启发了许多其他艺术家纷纷出版自己的批判性作品。
details.en: It is meant to challenge one's perception of oneself in relation to the higher social castes. The audience was encouraged to manipulate images of themselves as well as create distorted collages of popular political figures. As a counter-culture art collective, the Manifesti sought to challenge what they perceived to be an oppressive establishment. This piece has inspired many other artists to publish their own critical works.

short.zh: 一种甘甜多汁的水果，可以为大多数有机智慧生命提供几乎一天所需的营养
short.en: A sweet and pulpy fruit that provides nearly a day's worth of nutritional requirements for most organic sapient life

details.zh: 它母星的热带森林拥有独特的土壤成分，为其广泛传播提供了完美的环境。砂锅、甜品、鸡尾酒，这个星球上的殖民者几乎在所有的菜肴中都使用它。它的形象也被醒目地印在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]行星的旗帜上
details.en: The unique soil composition of its home planet's tropical forests have provided the perfect environment for its extensive proliferation. Colonists on this planet utilize it in nearly every culinary context; from casseroles, to cobblers, to cocktails. Its likeness is featured prominently on the flag of planet [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName].

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现种植这种果实的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this fruit is grown appears here.

short.zh: 这些遗骸是在对[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上大量的骨骼碎片进行深入检查时收集到的
short.en: These remains were collected during in-depth examination of the massive skeletal debris on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这是一艘活的星际舰船的一部分，分子分析显示其有机结构存在时间上的不规则性。据信，这个骨架和它的驾驶员是从异次元而来。内部扫描表明有一个管道网络，可能是某种生命维持系统或电源。
details.en: As part of a living starship, molecular analysis showed temporal irregularities in its organic construction. It is believed that the entire skeleton and its pilots journeyed here from outside of our dimension. Internal scans reveal a network of conduits that might have served as some sort of life support system or power supply.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些骨骼碎片所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these bone fragments lie appears here.

short.zh: 星系理事会的谢礼
short.en: A token of appreciation offered by the Galactic Council

details.zh: 其背面的铭文写道：“作为本奖项的获得者，[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的外交使团展现了其专业素养与得力代表领袖的能力，是星海共同体真正的宝贵财富。”
details.en: The inscription on its reverse side reads: "As the recipient of this award, the Diplomatic Corps of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] has shown their professionalism and ability to represent their leaders effectively and are a true asset to the galactic community."

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现获得这枚奖章的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that received this medal appears here.

short.zh: 灵能金属乐队“巨尸”所使用的弦乐器的残骸
short.en: The remains of a string instrument used by the psionic-metal group known as Megacorpse

details.zh: 这件装置据说是在虚境制成，最初打算用作声波武器。在科尔-阿赞主唱的操作下，它的音乐俘获了数十亿人的心，之后却在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上被粉碎，用荣耀的火焰摧毁所有观众。此后，相关专辑在大多数恒星系中被禁。
details.en: The device was said to be forged within the Shroud and was originally intended to be used as a sonic weapon. Wielded by performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan, its music captured the minds of billions before being shattered on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], destroying the entire audience in a blaze of glory. The associated album has since been banned in most systems.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这把超弦琴被摧毁的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this guitar was shattered appears here.

short.zh: 在多年的忠诚服役后，[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]与世长辞，在[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]心中留下了一个变形虫大小的、永远无法填补的空洞
short.en: After years of loyal service, [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] passed away, leaving an amoeba-sized hole in [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName] that can not be filled

details.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]不仅是一名忠诚的卫士，更是[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective]价值观之最佳体现的光辉典范。它虽已离去，但从未被遗忘。
details.en: Not only was [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] a loyal defender, but they were a shining example of what is possible when the best of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective] values are brought to light. They are gone, but not forgotten.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位纪念对象的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the person or unit being remembered appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现我们的势力形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for your own empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

short.zh: 为了纪念一场意外悲剧建立的纪念石碑
short.en: A commemorative stone created in memoriam of a tragic accident

details.zh: 在这个名为塞利卡的空间站上，过于急切的采矿作业导致它所在的小行星向内塌陷。矿井四分五裂，造成大量矿工伤亡。这颗小行星的碎片被保存了下来，上面刻着“赛利卡”，以纪念逝去的生命。
details.en: Over-eager mining operations on the station known as Selika caused the asteroid it was mounted on to collapse inward. The station split apart, inflicting a vast number of casualties among the miners. This fragment of the asteroid was kept, with "Selika" carved onto it in memory of the lives lost.

short.zh: 这就是在劫难逃的[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective]母星仅存的一切
short.en: This is all that remains of the doomed [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetAdjective] homeworld

details.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]是[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName]世世代代的家园，最终却悲剧性地自我撕裂。这座最后的纪念碑彰显了[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]意志之坚强——即使身处最艰难的境地，也能适应并克服：“我们会继续前行。”
details.en: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] was the home for every previous generation of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName] before it tragically tore itself apart. This final memorial highlights the strength of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]'s will, able to adapt and overcome even in the most challenging circumstances: "We will carry on."

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗已毁母星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the destroyed homeworld appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this species appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this species appears here.

short.zh: 从埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克意识中抽出的数据
short.en: Data pulled from the mind of Elik Narith Kerak

details.zh:
埃里克是一位虔诚的塞塔娜随从，她已经在假死状态下被冻结了数亿年。她的记忆在对塞塔娜纯洁的爱和与扎克兰追随者的暴力冲突之间切换。很明显，她目睹了许多卑鄙的暴行，但她的信念给了她继续前进的力量。

最后，在她那腐朽的心灵里只剩下一幅奇特的形象：§P塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。§!
details.en:
A devoted follower of Cetana, Elik has been frozen in suspended animation for hundreds of millions of years. Her memories shift between her pure love of Cetana and the violence and strife from conflicts with followers of Zarqlan. It is clear that she has seen many vile atrocities, but her faith gave her the strength to carry on.

In the end, all that remained of her decayed mind was a singular image: §PQueen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.§!

short.zh: 从个人记忆中以数字球体的形式提取的小过失和罪恶行为
short.en: Minor transgressions and sinful acts extracted from individual memories, in digital orb form

details.zh: 这些秘密的记忆是一个宗教性软体动物社会的产物，是在罪人忏悔后从他们的头脑中提取出来的。这样的丑闻回忆可以提供数千小时的短平快的娱乐节目。
details.en: A product of a religious molluscoid society, these secret moments were extracted from sinners' minds after their confession. Such scandalous recollections could provide thousands of hours of short-form, easily-digestible entertainment.

short.zh: 这个数字记录的故事最初是用采矿激光雕刻在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]地表上的
short.en: This digitally recorded tale was originally found carved into the surface of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] with a mining laser

details.zh: 它记录了一个漫游星系的年轻雇佣兵英年早逝的医生。这个传说的真实性无法确定，但肯定有人认为它很重要所以才会刻在一颗星球上。
details.en: It chronicles the life and untimely death of a young galaxy-roaming mercenary. Whether this legend is true or not cannot be determined, but someone thought it important enough to engrave on a planet.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个故事被刻下的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this story was carved appears here.

short.zh: 这种重金属化合物是[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上气候模式的主要成分
short.en: This compound of heavy metals is a major component of the weather patterns on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 从熔融的河流汇入巨大的金属海洋，然后蒸发到腐蚀性的大气中。一旦遇冷就会凝结，然后像雨一样落回炽热的地表。不建议在当前状态下访问[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]。
details.en: Flowing from molten rivers into a vast metallic sea, it would then evaporate into the corrosive atmosphere. Once cooled, it would condense and rain back down onto the scorched surface. It is not recommended to visit [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] in its current state.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种金属雪所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this metallic snow falls appears here.

short.zh: 从坠毁的奥霖巴利战舰上寻得的一件完整的奢华装饰品
short.en: Luxury decor found intact in the crashed Olinbari warship

details.zh:
除军事用途外，这艘舰船还曾用于与潜在的[EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetPreFTLLower]附庸国进行第一次接触。弥那玛特种实业集团以奢华与进步为诱饵，诓骗整个文明沦为他们的契约仆役，将其锁入不道德的合约，并以毁灭相威胁逼迫其就范。

§B启蒙或许并非免费。但在MSI这里，它永远物有所值。§!
details.en:
Outside of military use, this ship was also used for first contact operations with potential [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetPreFTLLower] client nations. Minamar Specialized Industries use the promise of luxury and progress to swindle entire civilizations into becoming their indentured servants, locking them into unethical contracts and threatening them with destruction if they do not comply.

§BEnlightenment may not be free. But at MSI, it is always worth the cost.§!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个文明在超光速前的阶段描述。
note.en: In the game, the pre-FTL description of this civilization appears here.

short.zh: 这个巨大石质物种的残骸是一个大脑器官，曾经在小行星内绕[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]轨道运行
short.en: Remains of a massive lithoid species, this is a cerebral organ that once orbited [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] inside of an asteroid

details.zh: 它将所有外部刺激视为自己思维过程的一部分，无法理解时间或运动距离等许多基本概念。这些数据存储在从矿质核心上逐渐生长出来的晶体中。它究竟是被放置在小行星内部还是自行在那里生长，我们无法确定。
details.en: It perceived all external stimuli as part of its own thought processes and was not able to track many basic concepts such as time or distance traveled. This data is stored in crystals grown over time with its mineral core. Whether it was placed inside of the asteroid or grew there independently, we cannot say for sure.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个小行星所绕行天体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the body this asteroid orbited appears here.

short.zh: 在星界裂隙另一侧发现的超致密微型星系里月球的残骸
short.en: The remains of a moon from within a hyperdense and miniaturized system discovered beyond an Astral Rift

details.zh: 被回收的月尘在我们的维度里表现得很特别。它高浓度的颗粒不断膨胀，需要随着时间的推移将标本转移到越来越大的容器中。
details.en: The dust that was retrieved behaves peculiarly inside of our dimension. Its hyper-concentrated particles continuously expand, requiring this specimen to be transferred to increasingly large containers over time.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]发现的一具用于标记大型贵金属矿藏的短距离发射器
short.en: A short-range transmitter found on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] used to mark a large deposit of precious metals

details.zh: 尽管年代久远，这个发射器的信号可以被各种各样的传感器接收，而且很容易追踪。其功能的持久运转证明了其强大的工程设计。
details.en: Despite its age, this transmitter's signal can be picked up on a wide variety of sensors and is easily traceable. Its continuing functionality is a testament to its robust engineering.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这具发射器所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this transmitter was found appears here.

short.zh: 史无前例的革命性化妆品，让生物长久年轻化
short.en: The first container of a revolutionary cosmetic known to provide long-lasting biological rejuvenation

details.zh: 它有多种用途，让任何有机物中的消费者都能保持年轻的光彩。关于毁容的副作用和毫无根据的非法获取成分的谣言仍然大行其道，这些谣言无法阻止这种化妆品令人难以置信的商业奇迹。
details.en: It has a multitude of uses, allowing consumers from any and every organic species to maintain their youthful glow. Baseless rumors regarding disfiguring side effects and illegally harvested ingredients still circulate, but this misinformation has not hampered the cosmetic's incredible commercial success.

short.zh: 来自一艘自动驱逐舰上的一颗无害化的导弹，它曾保护着一颗早已毁灭的行星
short.en: A disarmed missile from an automated destroyer defending the remains of a long-ruined planet

details.zh: 这艘船可能比它被创造来保卫的文明多续存了数千年，守护着一颗空荡荡的行星。在被摧毁之后，它的守夜终于结束了。
details.en: The ship had likely outlasted the civilization it was created to defend by thousands of years, keeping watch over an empty world. Following its destruction, its vigil has finally come to an end.

label.zh: 位于友方恒星系护盾承受值
label.en: Shield Hit Points in Friendly Systems

short.zh: 这个样本是从一颗特定轨道上的行星上采集的
short.en: This sample was harvested from a planet in a peculiar orbit

details.zh: 材料分析表明[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]它被短暂的时空异常拉进了一个极端的轨道，来自其恒星附近的强烈热量融化了这颗曾经适合居住的行星的大部分地幔。这颗行星的一部分因异常而发生了化学变化，不再对温度变化作出反应。
details.en: Material analysis indicates that [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] was pulled into an extreme orbit by a transient space-time anomaly, the intense heat from the proximity of its star melting much of the once-habitable planet's mantle. A portion of the planet was chemically altered by the anomaly and no longer reacts to changes in temperature.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗熔融星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this molten planet appears here.

short.zh: 悬浮在黑洞中的工蜂所经历的遥远平静的抽象化数字表现
short.en: An abstract digital representation of the distant calm experienced by biological drones suspended within a black hole

details.zh: 这些工蜂能够将[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]作为独立实体客观审视，同时保持与集体的连结。这种距离感赋予了他们深刻的洞见，使他们得以成为自身伟大故事的读者。
details.en: These drones were able to view [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] objectively as a separate entity while maintaining their connection to the collective. This distance offers them great insight, allowing them to exist as the readers of their own great story.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些工蜂所观察对象的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the entity these drones observed appears here.

short.zh: 增强版的“巨大蘑菇”，这些菌丝发射器可以以更高的速率收集和传输数据，从而提供更详细的监测报告
short.en: An enhanced version of the 'Fumongus,' these mycelial emitters can now collect and transmit data at a much higher rate, allowing for more detailed surveillance reports

details.zh: 这种扩容同时带来的是单个蘑菇大小的增长，而且还形成了一个类似无线电广播天线的新集群。
details.en: This increased capacity has caused the individual mushrooms to grow in size and create a new cluster formation that somewhat resembles a radio broadcast antenna.

short.zh: 从星界裂隙另一侧采集的一个部分机械的生物样本
short.en: Biological samples taken from a partially mechanical being found beyond an Astral Rift

details.zh: 这种生物拥有一种新颖的能力，可以在自己的消化系统中操纵其他生物的遗传结构。我们怀疑这一过程最初是作为对含有母星外生物质的行星的一种环境改造方法而发展起来的。
details.en: This creature possessed a novel ability to manipulate the genetic structure of other creatures from within its own digestive system. It is suspected that this process was initially developed as a method of terraforming planets containing biomass outside of their homeworld.

short.zh: 这面旗帜标志着[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]在[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]上的定居，由[EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName]慷慨相赠
short.en: This flag marked the settlement of the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] on [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName], generously gifted to them by [EVENT_TARGET_2.GetName]

details.zh: 厌倦了四海为家的游牧民在那里定居下来，回归了祖先的生活方式。毫无疑问，这一决定让殖民者们他们离开了世世代代居住的船只，这一定在他们的脑海中产生了深远的影响。
details.en: Nomads who grew tired of their itinerant lifestyle settled there, returning to the ways of their ancestors. No doubt that this decision weighed heavily in the minds of the colonists as they left behind the ships that had housed their people for generations.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这批定居者所属群体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the group that settled here appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这面旗帜所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this flag stands appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现赠送这面旗帜的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that gave this flag appears here.

short.zh: 一座混合媒介雕像，是加入[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]的一群逐浪者游牧民为表感激而建造的
short.en: A mixed-media statue built as a token of gratitude from a group of Pursuing Waters nomads joining the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 刚一在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]着陆，这些前游牧民就带来了他们杰出的科技专长。然而，他们不希望仅仅以修补匠和工程师的身份为人所知；这件作品证明了他们的艺术才华和穿越星系界的灵感。
details.en: Upon landing on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], the former nomads brought their extensive technological expertise. However, they did not wish to be known solely as tinkerers and engineers; this piece is a testament to their artistry and the inspiration that comes with journeying across the galaxy.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些前游牧民降落的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these former nomads landed appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这群人加入的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire these people joined appears here.

short.zh: 这些冠饰发现于纳马里安游牧民所造的舰船中，代表了逐浪者舰队上的诸多派系
short.en: Found within ships crafted by the Namarian Nomads, these crests represent the various factions within the Pursuing Waters fleet

details.zh: 平静的水池代表着居住舰，纳马里安人在这里休憩，种田，并进行大部分的家庭活动。浅水激流的造型标志着为工业和科学而设计的方舟舰，较老的中型舰船上配备了用于打捞和科学实验的各种器具。最后，汹涌的波峰代表着纳马里安的海军，训练有素的战士驾驶着坚固的船只，披坚执锐势不可挡。
details.en: The Calm Pools represent housing vessels, where Namarians sleep, grow food, and carry out the majority of their domestic activities. The emblem of the Shallow Rapids arkships designed for industrial and scientific use, older mid-size ships equipped with a variety of tools for everything from scavenging to scientific experimentation. Finally, the crest of the Raging Waters stands for the Namarian navy, trained combatants piloting sturdy vessels that can withstand significant firepower and dole it out just as well.

short.zh: 精心保存的由微观自复制纳米机械形成的复合物
short.en: A carefully preserved compound formed of microscopic, self-replicating nano-machines

details.zh: 这些纳米机器人的密度惊人，给它们所在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]增加了数十亿吨的质量。理论上讲，这些纳米机器人发生了故障，进入了一个无限制繁殖的阶段，完全吞没了它们的星球从而毁灭了之前的居民。这个特殊的标本已经完全无害化了。
details.en: The density of these nanites is astounding, adding billions of tons of mass to [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] where they were discovered. It is theorized that these nanites malfunctioned and entered a phase of unrestricted reproduction, engulfing their planet completely and thus dooming its previous inhabitants. This particular specimen has been completely neutralized.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这些纳米机器人的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these nanites were discovered appears here.

short.zh: 曾伫立在星界裂隙另一侧的火山位面中心方尖碑的碎片
short.en: A fragment of an obelisk that once stood at the center of a volcanic plane beyond an Astral Rift

details.zh: 在其流变的符号中编码着成千上万个个体的名字及相关的罪行。这个装置被应该是一个巨大次元监狱的主控面板。
details.en: Encoded in its shifting symbols are the names of thousands of individuals and their associated crimes. This device is believed to have been used as the primary control panel for a massive dimensional prison.

short.zh: 一幅完全由油基颜料绘制的宁静画面，上面有白雪皑皑的山脉，近处是寒带森林
short.en: A serene depiction of snow-capped mountains with a boreal forest shown in the foreground, composed entirely of oil-based pigments

details.zh: 虽然这是大多数具有可抓握附肢的物种的标准艺术表达，但这位艺术家似乎特别熟练。
details.en: While a standard expression of art in most species with prehensile appendages, this particular artist appears to have been especially skilled.

short.zh: 在巴奥[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]殖民地的残骸中找到的有机计算机化石
short.en: A fossilized organic computer found within the ruins of the Baol colony on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这件装置是生物工程的一个了不起的壮举，用于教育整合进蜂巢之前的年轻树苗。恢复的文件详细介绍了创新的生态管理技术，这些技术只有通过这种特殊物种独特的生理功能才能实现。他们周围的星球不是建造出来的，而是栽培出来的。
details.en: Used to educate young saplings prior to hive integration, this device is a remarkable feat of bio-engineering. Recovered files detail innovative eco-management techniques made possible only by this particular species' unique biology. The worlds around them were not built, but cultivated.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这台计算机化石所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this fossil was found appears here.

short.zh: 一座纪念雕像，为表彰[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesName]有机人口在[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]地磁太阳风暴期间所提供的服务而立
short.en: A commemorative statue in recognition of the service provided by [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetSpeciesName] bio-pops during a geomagnetic solar storm in [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 有机人口介入支持的机械仆人，代替故障的看护单元进行工作。这件作品是由有艺术倾向的有机体和专门的焊接无人机设计的。
details.en: The organic population stepped in to support their mechanical servitors, carrying out the work of malfunctioning caretaker units. This piece was designed by artistically inclined organics and specialized welding drones.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些有机人口所属物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species of these organic workers appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发生这场太阳风暴的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this solar storm happened appears here.

short.zh: 欧林提持续生长的牙齿
short.en: The still-growing teeth of an Orinthi

details.zh: 一种小型类鼠生物，欧林提在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的地下钻出了一座横亘星球的巨大迷宫。他们的天然牙齿小且中空，但是一种角质真菌的伴生物种栖息在欧林提的牙齿上，形成锋利、易碎的尖牙。
details.en: Small rodent-like creatures, the Orinthi had carved world-spanning labyrinthine burrows throughout [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]. Their natural teeth are small and hollow, but a partner species of keratinous fungus inhabits each individual tooth and forms sharp, brittle fangs for the Orinthi to use.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些地下迷宫所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these burrows were dug appears here.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上用作建筑资源的巨大骨骼
short.en: These massive bones were used as a material resource on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 一种具有遗传性软组织骨化爬行动物被大规模饲养，用于获取建筑材料。分析表明，这种爬行动物有多种其他遗传缺陷，比如可能由于近亲繁殖而导致的无蹼脚。这些动物中的大多数在收获前都被人道地安乐死。
details.en: A species of reptile with genetic soft-tissue ossification was bred extensively to be harvested for building supplies. Analysis shows that the reptile had a variety of other genetic deficiencies such as unwebbed feet potentially due to inbreeding. The majority of these creatures were humanely euthanized before harvesting took place.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些建材所用星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these materials were used appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetName]工业使命宣言的正式呈递本
short.en: A formal presentation of the [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetName] industrial mission statement

details.zh: 不惜一切代价追求增长与提升客户满意度，是[EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetAdjective]意识形态的核心信条。将行星变为辐射废土，是这场无尽进步追逐中的必要一步。
details.en: The desire for growth and improved customer satisfaction at any cost is a core tenet of [EVENT_TARGET_0.Owner.GetAdjective] ideology. Turning planets into irradiated wastelands is a necessary step in the endless pursuit of progress.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个帝国意识形态的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this empire's ideology appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发出这份使命宣言的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that issued this mission statement appears here.

short.zh: 一座极为精密的原子钟，发现于[event_target:atomic_clock_system.GetName]，出自无名工匠之手
short.en: A highly precise atomic clock found in [event_target:atomic_clock_system.GetName] crafted by unknown makers

details.zh: 当被发现时，它正倒数到42年零3天，但不知道在那之前它倒数了多久。在数到0的时候，它释放了一群带有神秘的命令的纳米机器人。尽管它的有效载荷和使命已经结束，但它的功能仍然完美。
details.en: When discovered, it was counting down 42 years and 3 days, but there is no knowing how long it was counting before that. At the count of zero, it released a stream of stored nanites with a set of mysterious orders. It remains perfectly functional, though its payload and purpose is spent.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这座原子钟所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where this atomic clock was found appears here.

short.zh: 悬浮在黑洞中的工蜂所遭受的暂时痛苦的抽象数字表现
short.en: An abstract digital representation of the temporal anguish suffered by drones suspended within a black hole

details.zh: 这些工蜂长期处于一种似曾相识的状态；不安，渴望着一种早已被遗忘的感觉。这种不祥的预感至今仍隐约萦绕于[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective]思维之网中。
details.en: These drones existed in a perennial state of deja-vu; uneasy, yearning for a feeling that has been long-forgotten. This foreboding sensation is still loosely detected across the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective] mindweave.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些工蜂所属集体的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the collective these drones belong to appears here.

short.zh: 虽然晶体形式的碳在我们的星系中并不罕见，但特别值得注意的是这个标本完全没有任何内部或外部的包裹体
short.en: While carbon in its crystalline form is not such a rare find in our galaxy, this specimen is especially notable for its complete lack of any internal or external inclusions

details.zh: 不管是谁之前拥有这件物品想必都花了很多的时间雕刻它，才能突出这些显著的特征。
details.en: Whoever was previously in possession of this item took the time to carve it in such a way as to highlight these remarkable features.

short.zh: 一种用来对驯养的小型哺乳动物表示所有权的项链
short.en: A necklace used to designate ownership over a small domesticated mammal

details.zh: 这件项圈最初由[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]使者[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]所使用，以防其爱宠走失。如今它已被更可靠的嵌入式微芯片取代。这只喜怒无常的小生物常常扰乱主人的工作站，每当[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]用[EVENT_TARGET_0.Species.GetHandName]抚摸它的头时，它都会发出满足的鸣颤。
details.en: This was initially used by [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName] envoy [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] in the event that their valued companion were to get lost. It has since been replaced with a more reliable embedded microchip. The temperamental creature could often be found disrupting their owner's workstation, and would release a satisfied tonal flutter whenever [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] touched its head with their [EVENT_TARGET_0.Species.GetHandName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位使者的名字。
note.en: In the game, the envoy's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位使者物种的手部称呼。
note.en: In the game, the word for this envoy's species hand appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the other empire's name appears here.

short.zh: 佩里坎联盟是一个能工巧匠社会，以制造极端奢华的物品闻名
short.en: The Perikan Union was a society of master craftsmen known for creating exquisite luxury goods

details.zh: 这颗宝石是传奇珠宝商贝迪尔·塔皮科的杰作。塔皮科仅用简单的凿子就雕刻了这颗巨大的宝石，并使用炼金术液化了它的中心。漂浮在宝石内部的晶体是通过精密激光形成的，通过对矿物分子进行过加热，形成更小、更暗的宝石，同时保持外部完整。
details.en: This gem was the masterpiece of the legendary jeweler known as Bedeers Tapico. Tapico faceted this enormous gem with a simple chisel over a period of years and used alchemical techniques to liquify its center. The crystals floating within the jewel were formed with precision lasers, superheating the mineral molecules to reform smaller, darker gems while leaving the exterior intact.

short.zh: 曾被称为“风暴召唤器”的一台装置被毁坏后的一片碎片
short.en: A fragment of the destroyed device once known as the "Tempest Invocator"

details.zh: 尽管只是一个破碎的碎片，它依然充满了恶毒的灵能。它被保存在一个屏蔽的环境中，以便安全观察。
details.en: Despite being only a shattered piece, it pulses with malevolent psionic energy.  It is contained here in a shielded environment to allow for safe observation.

short.zh: 一份描述了在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上被称为“揭纱秘仪”的神圣仪式的宗教文献
short.en: A religious document describing a holy ritual known as "The Rite of Lifted Veil" on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 指示概述了一系列的要由一群人站在精心组织的多级队形中齐声重唱的圣歌。从理论上讲，这一过程能够在这种特殊的物种中建立一种新颖而有效的催眠状态。
details.en: Instructions outline a series of chantings to be repeated in unison by a crowd standing in carefully organized hierarchical formations. In theory, this procedure is capable of establishing a novel and effective state of hypnosis in this particular species.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这份圣典所属星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet this ritual belongs to appears here.

short.zh: 这些蔗糖晶体能够通过吸收太阳辐射和某些小行星中存在的特定矿物质而繁殖
short.en: These sucrose crystals are able to multiply by absorbing solar radiation and specific minerals present within certain asteroids

details.zh: 由于非常易碎，它们相对容易培育和加工。其工业应用范围包括食品、特殊聚合物以及药物开发。
details.en: Due to their extremely brittle nature, they are relatively easy to cultivate and process. Their industrial applications range from foodstuffs to the development of specialized polymers and medicine.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些晶体所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these crystals grow appears here.

short.zh: 这些巨大的推进装置串联在一起，理论上能够影响小型行星的轨道
short.en: These massive propulsion devices, when connected in series, are theoretically capable of influencing a small planet's orbit

details.zh: 这些推力阵列的安装系统被设计成在不影响行星自转的情况下推动行星。这种发动机技术的主要后勤问题是维持其使用所需的燃料数量过多，需要整个文明的协调才能维持它的运作。
details.en: The intended mounting system for these thrusting arrays is designed to push the planet without affecting its rotation. The main logistical concern with this type of engine technology would be the inordinate quantity of fuel required to sustain its use. It would take the coordination of an entire civilization to maintain its operation.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的森林中发现，这些天然的果肉根营养价值很高
short.en: Found in the forests of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], these naturally pulpy roots have been found to be highly nutritious

details.zh: 通过精心的管理，只收获它们庞大网络中的一部分，就可以让寄主植物在支持殖民地发展的同时生存下来。我们已经开始试验一种简单的基因修饰，可以将这些根嫁接到现有的作物上，以提高产量。
details.en: With careful management, harvesting only a portion of their extensive networks allow the host plants to survive while supporting developing colonies. We have already begun experimenting with a simple genetic modification that will allow the grafting if these roots into existing crops for an extra yield to the harvests.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些超级根茎所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these super roots grow appears here.

short.zh: 为肆虐[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的突变疾病研发的特效药
short.en: The miracle cure developed for the mutating disease that plagued [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这个处方是通过使用人工智能预测算法来绘制出疾病的所有可能变体，并确定整体的基本弱点而开发的。它的发明是医学科学领域的一个里程碑式的进步。
details.en: This formula was developed by using AI predictive algorithms to map out all of the possible variants of the disease and identify a fundamental weakness common to the whole. Its creation was a landmark advancement in the field of medical science.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种疾病肆虐的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet plagued by this disease appears here.

short.zh: 一个行星尺度的雕塑的例子，其原材料为[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的表面
short.en: An example of sculpture on a planetary scale using the surface of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] as raw material

details.zh: 配备强大激光的无人机被用来在整个大陆、完美的球形山脉和难以置信的复杂洞穴系统上雕刻精确的线条。上传到中央控制卫星上的设计示意图说明了为该项目开发的大规模后勤规划和艺术考量。不幸的是，它在真正完成之前就被遗弃了。
details.en: Drones armed with powerful lasers were used to carve precise lines through entire continents, perfectly spherical mountains, and impossibly intricate cavern systems. The design schematics uploaded on their central control satellite illustrate an extensive level of logistical planning and artistic consideration developed for this project. Unfortunately, it was abandoned before it was ever truly completed.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这件行星雕塑所用星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet used as raw material appears here.

short.zh: 一具强方向性电磁铁的一部分
short.en: A portion of a powerful directional electromagnet

details.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]星球上的古代居民愚蠢地用这个装置拉近了他们星球的卫星，以便更容易地收获珍贵的金属矿石。这种方法有效到充满金属的卫星直接撞向行星表面，并在由此产生的影响中灭绝了所有的居民。这个标本只是从行星尺度机器中取回的一小部分。
details.en: The ancient inhabitants of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] foolishly used this device to bring their planet's moon closer in order to more easily harvest its valuable metal ores. This approach was too effective, bringing the metal-filled moon crashing into the planet's surface and exterminating every inhabitant in the resulting impact. This specimen is only a small fraction of what could be recovered from the planet-spanning machine.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些古代居民所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these ancient inhabitants lived appears here.

short.zh: 一种高度工程设计的设备，能够记录复杂的图案，创造抽象的谜题
short.en: A highly engineered device capable of registering complicated patterns to create abstract puzzles

details.zh: 最初的碎片是在一座巨大的人造结构中发现的，作为对探险家智力的测试。这个立方体已经被复制供消费者使用，允许个体为彼此编写自己的拼图，或者只是用来保护自己的财物。
details.en: The original piece was found within a vast artificial construct as a test of an explorer's intellect. This cube has since been replicated for consumer use, allowing individuals to program their own puzzles for one another or simply safeguard their belongings.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]内出现的纯灵能实体的残余
short.en: All that remains of an entity of pure psionic energy found within [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 它是在一个时空裂隙中被发现的，这个时空裂缝让来自整个星系的能量汇聚于此。他是一种集中的恶意形式，可能被故意从超空间航道网络中隔离了亿万年，直到最近才被发现。
details.en: It was discovered emerging from a temporal rift that allowed energy from across the galaxy to pool in a single location. Malevolence in concentrated form, it may have been purposely isolated from the hyperlane network for eons until its recent discovery.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这份灵能残留被发现的星系名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where this residue was found appears here.

short.zh: 这是一种使用强力放射性诱变剂进行仪式的物种的遗骸
short.en: The remains of a species that carried out ritualistic ceremonies involving powerful radioactive mutagens

details.zh: 每个突变都是一个神迹，被解读为个体命运的表现。随着时间的推移，这一过程慢慢破坏了物种的遗传结构，削弱了它们的免疫系统，使种群极易受到各种疾病的侵害。
details.en: Each mutation was a sacred event, interpreted as a manifestation of the individual's destiny. Over time, this procedure destabilized the genetic structure of the species and weakened their immune system, making the population extremely vulnerable to disease.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的天气模式中发现的独特紫雨的艺术图像
short.en: Artistic images taken of the uniquely purple rain found present in the weather patterns of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 据说，观察这种激发想象的意象对缓解悲伤和痛苦的年头很有效。
details.en: It is said that observing this evocative imagery is effective in relieving thoughts of sorrow and pain.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种紫雨出现的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this purple rain falls appears here.

short.zh: 这块不稳定的矿物在目前状况下没有贸易或工业的价值
short.en: This unstable mineral has no commercial or industrial use in its current state

details.zh: 然而，由于其独特的反应性质，它有可能在特定条件下引发完全的交代变化。这个标本被包裹在一个含铅的观察窗口中，以限制放射性和电轰击。
details.en: However, due to its uniquely reactive properties, it is possible to trigger a complete metasomatic change under specific conditions. This specimen is encased in a lead-infused viewing window that limits radioactive and electrical bombardment.

short.zh: 弥那玛特种实业集团发来的战争赔款发票
short.en: An invoice for war reparations sent by Minamar Specialized Industries

details.zh: 由星际信贷管理公司起草的这份清单，详列了[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]摆脱所谓“仁善公司”契约奴役时所损失的一切军事资产。这家寰宇企业期望这些损失获得赔付，甚至声称触碰[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective]领空内的被毁舰船也将构成进一步违约。
details.en: Drafted by the Interstellar Credit Management Company, this list details every military asset lost when [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] broke free of their indentured servitude to the so-called "Benevolent Corporation". The MegaCorp expects to be reimbursed for these damages, and even claims that touching the destroyed ships in [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective] space would be a further breach of contract.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for your empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

short.zh: 这种无人机的原是星球卫生协议的一部分，无意中将其创造者的整颗母星变得完全无菌
short.en: This drone design was part of a planet-wide sanitation protocol that inadvertently rendered its creators' homeworld completely sterile

details.zh: 它用途极广，可凭借多向推进器系统完成复杂的空中机动。这台机器经逆向工程改造后，被用于识别和分类异星动植物，随后又被大量生产，以协助整个[EVENT_TARGET_0.explorer.GetName]的殖民工作。作为预防措施，其所有清洁子例程都已被抹除。
details.en: It is highly versatile and can perform complex aerial maneuvers with its system of multi-directional thrusters. This machine was reverse-engineered and repurposed to identify and categorize alien flora and fauna, and subsequently has been mass-produced to assist with colonization efforts across the [EVENT_TARGET_0.explorer.GetName]. As a precaution, all of its cleansing subroutines have been erased.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个殖民扩张帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the colonizing empire appears here.

short.zh: 这种晶体能够吸收任何频率的太阳辐射并发生共振，在这个过程中产生万花筒一般的光效
short.en: This crystal is able to absorb and resonate any frequency of solar radiation, creating a kaleidoscopic display in the process

details.zh: 这不仅是视觉上的奇迹，而且可以帮助开发基于能源的武器或工具。这颗宝石也引起了星系珠宝行业的极大兴趣。
details.en: Not only is this a visual marvel, but it could aid in the development of energy-based weapons or tools. This gem has also sparked great interest within the galactic jewelry industry.

name.zh: 雷塔拉克斯狩猎战利品

short.zh: 狩猎各种各样智慧物种所获得的战利品收藏
short.en: A collection of hunting trophies harvested from a wide variety of sapient species

details.zh: 这些都是从马克维尔之收集来的，在那里，雷塔拉克斯人会猎杀从他们的许多附庸国虏来的公民取乐。所有的遗骸都保存完好，每个都有一个小匾，详细说明了战利品的信息：物种、名字、年龄和以前的职业。
details.en: These were collected from the Valley of Mak'vaehl, where the Retarax would hunt citizens pulled from their many vassal states for sport. All remains have been preserved in immaculate condition, each with a small plaque detailing the trophy's features: species, name, age, and former profession.

label.zh: 太空兽群舰船克隆速度

short.zh: 这是5000多年前一位很有影响力的商人的奢华服装
short.en: The luxurious attire of an influential merchant from over 5000 years ago

details.zh: 这位“黄金掮客”带领绰尔的罗盘贸易站进入了一个无与伦比的繁荣时代。他戴着金色面具，穿着这身舒适奢华的长袍，谈着纵横星系的贸易协定。不幸的是，黄金掮客的统治在他的纯金星际飞船在一次劫机行动中毁于一旦。
details.en: The "Golden Broker" led the Chor's Compass merchant station into an era of unrivaled prosperity. Anonymous under a golden mask, they wore this comfortable and luxurious robe while negotiating galaxy-spanning trade agreements. The Golden Broker's reign was sadly cut short after their pure-gold starship was destroyed in a hijacking attempt gone awry.

short.zh: 大型胶状无脊椎动物的冷冻化石残骸
short.en: Cryo-fossilized remains of large gelatinous invertebrates

details.zh: 从表面上看，这些钙化的遗骸类似于岩层，但事实上，这些本土动物曾经是[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]星球上的主要生命形式。在该行星最近的一次冰河时代之后，这个物种几乎就灭绝了。它们的残骸在腐烂的过程中会逐渐凝固，最终形成巨大的、漂浮的伪岛屿。
details.en: On a superficial level, these calcified remains resemble rock formations, but in fact this native fauna were once the dominant lifeform on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]. Following the planet's most recent ice age, the species was rendered nearly extinct. Their remains would solidify as they decayed, eventually forming massive, floating pseudo-islands.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些化石所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where these fossils lie appears here.

name.zh: 鲁达里死亡激光原型机

short.zh: 一把由早已消亡的鲁达里仓促拼装的武器化激光器，发现于[EVENT_TARGET_0.solar_system.GetName]的一座空间站上
short.en: A weaponized laser hastily assembled by the long-dead Rudari, found on a station in [EVENT_TARGET_0.solar_system.GetName]

details.zh: 这个匆忙拼凑起来的大规模杀伤性武器是鲁达里种族对抗波格-莫里的最后一招。最终，激光在启动后就自毁了。
details.en: This hacked-together weapon of mass destruction was created as the final gambit for the Rudari species in their war against the Pogg-Mory. In the end, the laser simply self-destructed upon activation.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发现这具激光原型机的星系名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where this laser prototype was found appears here.

short.zh: 萨阿里亚的记忆记录，他是眠梦仪潜意识系统的首席开发者
short.en: The recorded memories of Saariah, the lead developer of the Memorex subconscious system

details.zh: 萨阿里亚的任务是消除集体记忆，以适应星球的领导层，但一次故障最终清除了人们的思想。由于无法恢复他们的记忆，萨阿里亚拆除了栖息地的生命维持设备，任其自行消亡。这些设备中的每一个都具有令人难以置信的原始计算能力，它们本身就是一项成就。
details.en: Saariah was tasked with removing collective memories to suit the planet's leadership, but a malfunction eventually wiped the population's minds clean. Unable to recover their memories, Saariah removed the habitat's life support and left it to perish. Each of these devices are incredibly dense with raw computational power and are an achievement unto themselves.

short.zh: 一个以气味为媒介编码信息的存储设备
short.en: A cache of information encoded in the medium of scent

details.zh: 里面的数据要么是有趣的叙述的集合，要么是对各种有机排泄物的细致记录。复制这种嗅觉数据存储技术是可行的，但除了新奇之外，它没有任何实用价值。
details.en: The data within is either a collection of interesting narratives, or the meticulous recordings of various organic excretions in high detail. Replicating this olfactory data storage technique is feasible, but it offers zero practical utility outside of novelty alone.

short.zh: 说书人特丽莎的哲学思考
short.en: The philosophical musings of Telisa, Teller of Tales

details.zh: 她探讨了各种修辞主题以及科学方法的核心原则。这些文章挑战了客观真理的概念，鼓励了批判性思维。
details.en: She explores a variety of rhetorical topics as well as the core principles of the scientific method. Inside these texts, the very concept of objective truth is challenged and critical thinking is encouraged.

short.zh: 被称为黑王冠的星系星门的详细示意图
short.en: A detailed schematic of the intergalactic gateway known as the Black Crown

details.zh: 这份数据是星门神秘创造者送出的最后礼物，旨在保存他们不可思议的科技。这份托付交给了[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]，其星门技术的力量与威严至今无可匹敌。
details.en: This data was transmitted as a final gift from the gateway's enigmatic creators as a way to preserve their incredible technology. Entrusted to the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], the power and majesty of their gateway technology is unmatched to this day.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现接受这份数据的族群名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the people who received this data appears here.

short.zh: 森贝拉米游牧民的成员端来接受施舍的碗
short.en: A bowl carried by members of the Sembelami Nomads to accept charity

details.zh: 这些苦行僧在他们的轨道寺庙被一个不断扩张的企业帝国摧毁后，开始进行一种“道德”的海盗行为。他们从富有的寰宇企业劫富济贫，资助难民哨站。他们则完全依靠难民回馈给他们的捐款生存下来。
details.en: These ascetic travelers committed a form of 'ethical' piracy after their orbital temple was destroyed by an expanding corporate empire. They stole from wealthy mega-corporations and used their earnings to fund refugee outposts. They survived entirely off of the donations received from the refugees they supported.

short.zh: 在和乐族乌托邦的废墟中找到的环境改造数据库
short.en: A terraforming database found amongst the ruins of the Shallarian utopia

details.zh: 在遭[event_target:fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesName]灭族之前，和乐族曾建造了一套利用六颗等距卫星的气候管理系统。在他们不幸陨落之前，和乐族还计划环境改造不宜居的行星，以安置和供养难民人口。
details.en: Exterminated by the [event_target:fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesName], the Shallarians created a climate management system using six equidistant moons. Before their untimely demise, the Shallarians had planned to terraform uninhabited planets in order to house and support refugee populations.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现消灭和乐族的那个物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species that wiped out the Shallarians appears here.

short.zh: 一份由[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]的[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]所控制的自动化船坞的蓝图
short.en: A blueprint of an automated shipyard controlled by the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 在这座被其创造者遗弃的外星船坞被发现后，该组织的总工程师对其进行了翻新，以便为他们误入歧途的生产军用舰队。这座造船坞里完成的最后一个记录在案的项目是一艘装备了先进战斗载荷的令人印象深刻的旗舰。这座建筑群能如此容易地就被重新启用，也证明了其初始设计师的聪明才智。
details.en: Having found this shipyard abandoned by its alien creators, the organization's chief engineer refurbished it to produce military fleets for their misguided cause. The last recorded project to be completed at this shipyard was an impressive flagship vessel equipped with an advanced combat loadout. For this complex to be so easily repurposed is evidence of the genius of its original designers.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现控制这座船坞的组织名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the organization that controlled this shipyard appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个组织所属帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire this organization belonged to appears here.

short.zh: 这座庆祝雕像受托建造，以彰显[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]与长期环绕[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetHomeWorldName]运行的“天龙”之间的协作
short.en: This celebratory statue was commissioned to represent the collaboration between [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] and the "Sky Dragon" that has long orbited [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetHomeWorldName]

details.zh: 认定[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective]社会配得上之后，这只生物宣誓以其自身及后代提供军事支援，以换取让幼崽在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective]领空中成长的许可。据说这些太空生物会等待千年寻找适合哺育幼崽的宿主，且只会选择一颗行星。
details.en: Having deemed the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective] society worthy, the creature pledged itself and its offspring in military support in exchange for the opportunity to raise its young in [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetAdjective] space. It is said these spaceborne creatures can wait millennia to find a suitable host for their young, and only ever choose one planet.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个社会的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this society appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个社会母星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this society's home planet appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个社会的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this society appears here.

short.zh: 一尊斯密吉卜的雕塑，这是奈斯船长的蜂巢思维伙伴
short.en: A statue of Smeegibb, the hive-minded companions of Captain Ness

details.zh: 斯密吉卜是忠诚的仆人，在这位传奇海盗的职业生涯后期担任着全部船员和跳帮战队的职位。这座仅存的雕像是在黑针军团袭击他们的小定居点后从残留的遗迹里修复出来。
details.en: Smeegibb was a loyal servant, functioning as the legendary pirate's entire crew and boarding party in the latter stages of her career. This reconstructed statue was all that remained after the Black Needle's attack on their small settlement.

short.zh: 在一种被称为萨尼兰的生物背上取下的长刺
short.en: Tall spikes found on the back of a creature known as a Sniran

details.zh: 萨尼兰是一种大型伏击掠食者，它们藏身在原生沙丘下，当发现表面有动静时，就会伸出起致命的尖刺。尽管体型庞大，这些生物的身体却非常脆弱。它们细长的网状鳞片使它们能够在沙子下无声地滑行，但也很容易被刺穿。据推测，这也有助于它们的生殖过程。
details.en: Snirans are large ambush predators, lying beneath their native sand dunes and raising deadly spikes whenever they detect movement on the surface above. Despite their large size, the bodies of these creatures are surprisingly fragile. Their thin, reticulated scales allow them to glide silently under the sand, but can be pierced quite easily. It is speculated that this aids in their reproductive processes.

short.zh: 一个刻有特殊科学符号的多棱柱棱镜，这个物体只反射某一频率以下的能量波
short.en: A polygonal prism engraved with peculiar scientific notation, this object only reflects energy waves below a certain frequency

details.zh: 也许起初是某个文明的测量仪器，它也能用于美学、音乐表演和声学。
details.en: Perhaps originally a measuring device of some kind, it also can be utilized for aesthetic purposes in musical performance and acoustics.

short.zh: 瑟里兹·柯哈尔撰写的关于太空兽群的现场指导
short.en: A field guide to spaceborne fauna written by Ceriz t'Xal

details.zh: 该书通过谚语和原始哲学来解释“狩猎的艺术”。其中详细描述太空生物的进食和迁徙模式，并介绍了如何绕过每种生物的天然防御，揭示了许多可以利用的弱点。
details.en: It explains the "Art of the Hunt" by way of proverbs and primal philosophies. Detailed insights into the feeding and migration patterns of spaceborne creatures are provided within. The text offers practical instructions on how to bypass each creature's natural defenses, revealing multiple weak points to be exploited.

short.zh: 茹克·恰卜鲁克撰写的异种学论文集
short.en: A collection of xenological theses written by Ruuk Qabruuk

details.zh: 这本研究巨著为太空生命的行为模式提供了深入的见解；包括交配仪式、迁徙路线、物种间交流等等。还有一节关于使用独特的物理特征和音调来识别单个标本。
details.en: This body of research offers in-depth insight into the behavioral patterns of spaceborne life; mating rituals, migratory routes, interspecies communication and more. There is also a section on identifying individual specimens using unique physical features and tonal recognition.

short.zh: 一种大型的复杂装置，理论上认为是为娱乐而设计的
short.en: A large and complex contraption theorized to be designed for amusement

details.zh: 这个缠绕的装置被废弃在一个有许多不同颜色和材料的类似结构的区域。据说，在特定的重力水平下沿着它的螺旋路径下降能令人感到兴奋。
details.en: This winding installation was abandoned in an area housing many similar structures of various colors and material. Descending along its coiled path within a specific level of gravity is said to be thrilling.

short.zh: 为纪念[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的成立而制作的雕塑
short.en: A sculpture made in commemoration of the formation of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 挣脱了奴隶制的枷锁，苦难的过去将他们牢牢团结在一起，去创造一个更光明的未来。雕像上的每一个链环都刻着创始成员的名字。
details.en: Broken free from the chains of slavery, their shared and troubled past unites them in creating a more promising future. Each link in the sculpture's chain has the name of a founding member engraved upon it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个群体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this group appears here.

short.zh: 在过去会提供给每个游客的一张地图，这里曾被称为“星达广场”
short.en: A map once provided to each visitor to a location known once known as "Star Mall"

details.zh: 作为星际消费商业的旧址，星达广场建有大量的便利设施，包括明亮的水疗中心，完美的营养庭院。这张地图提供了无数商家的信息，包括科瑞克运动商品、麦克斯金丝雀连锁店、建造鹦鹉工作室、种子蛋糕工坊等等。
details.en: The former home of intergalactic consumer commerce, the Star Mall boasted a huge number of amenities from illuminating spas to succulent nutrition courts. This map provides information on a vast number of outlets including Koriik's Sporting Goods, T. Canary. Maxx, Build-A-Budgerigar, and Seedcake Factory.

short.zh: 一种在超新星爆发后短时间内收集到的高密度重金属
short.en: A condensed mass of heavy metals collected shortly after a supernova explosion

details.zh: 该样品究竟是如何采集的对我们来说是一个谜，但它在研究恒星演化和组成方面具有显著的科学价值。
details.en: How this recovery was done is a mystery to us, but its scientific value in the studying of stellar evolution and composition are remarkable.

short.zh: 一罐自组装沙子
short.en: A jar of self-sorting sand

details.zh: 这些微小的硅酸盐颗粒似乎展现出了一定程度的意识，会将相似的矿物质在看似随机的水平面上相互组合。尽管有这种能力，沙子却不具备任何其他生命的基本特征。
details.en: These tiny silicate particles seem to exhibit a low level of sentience, with similar minerals grouping with one another across random horizontal planes. Despite this ability, the sand does not possess any of the other primary characteristics of life.

short.zh: 发生传奇事故的亚光速飞船的方向杠杆
short.en: The directional lever from a sublight spacecraft involved in a legendary accident

details.zh: 舒勒巴斯特号客船在奥德良王国的两个殖民地之间运载平民时，恒星耀斑爆发导致了飞船引擎的严重故障，这通常会导致灾难性后果。飞行员克服重重困难，手动控制匹配速度，成功地将飞船安全降落在一颗经过的小行星上。舒勒巴斯特号随后退役，并在公共场所进行展示。
details.en: The Sullebaster passenger ship was transporting civilians between two colonies of the Odelian Kingdom when a solar flare caused a critical malfunction in the vessel's engines that would usually guarantee disaster. Against all odds, the pilot managed to safely land the vessel on a passing asteroid by matching velocities using manual control. The Sullebaster was subsequently decommissioned and mounted for public display.

short.zh: 来自其他维度的一丛智慧真菌
short.en: A cluster of intelligent fungus from another dimension

details.zh: 这种“果实”与一种高度危险的杂食性植物保持共生关系。每一簇菌落都是这对有机体的思想中心，协调着它们复杂的防御行为模式。
details.en: This 'fruit' maintains a symbiotic relationship with a species of highly dangerous omnivorous plant. Each colony of fungus functions as the thought center for the organism pair, orchestrating its complex patterns of defensive behavior.

label.zh: 主要物种没有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species lacks the Thermophile trait

label.zh: 主要物种拥有「嗜热者」特质
label.en: Main species has the Thermophile trait

short.zh: 塔布拉克的一种闪闪发光的薄纱状膜片
short.en: A sparkling veil-like membrane of a Tarblac

details.zh: 这种生物创新性地使用灵能来捕猎和自我保护。它们通过施加一种压倒一切的恐惧感使猎物无法动弹，或以此恐吓掠食者。这个标本被保存在一个罐子里，里面装着它的原生水体，它的心灵感应能力已经丧失了。
details.en: This creature makes novel use of psionics to hunt and protect itself, inflicting a sense of overwhelming dread to immobilize prey and intimidate predators. This specimen is preserved in a jar of its native waters and has been rendered telepathically inert.

short.zh: 一个成功在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]实施的环境改造项目的比例模型，展现了对[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName]母星的近乎完美的再现。
short.en: A scale model of the successful terraforming project on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], representing a near perfect recreation of the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetSpeciesName] homeworld

details.zh: 该行星现在生长着完全相同的生物群系，哪怕下至微观层面，甚至连[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetHomeWorldName]最独特的夸群系生态系统行为都完美复刻。
details.en: The planet is now populated by identical fauna down to the microscopic level, and even the most specific cross-biome ecosystems behave just as they do on [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetHomeWorldName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个改造项目所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this terraforming project took place appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一物种母星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other species' homeworld appears here.
