short.zh: 一种古老的环境改造科技中使用的微型装置
short.en: Tiny devices used as part of an ancient form of terraforming technology

details.zh: 这些微小的机器是设计用于散布到整个行星的表面上、对现有的有机物和矿物质应运更理想气候进行改造。这组机器人用于操控生态群系内的气候模式，并复制新的动植物以管理新造的生态系统。
details.en: These miniature machines were designed to spread out across a planet's surface and convert the existing organic and mineral matter to suit a more desirable climate. Teams of these robots were used to manipulate weather patterns within biomes and replicate new plants and animals to manage the newly-crafted ecosystems.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]进行环境改造的流程中，所有生物形式都是行为同步的，从而形成了一个物流天堂。在这个天堂里，每一种动植物都在其生态系统中有着自己的位置。
short.en: All lifeforms on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] were behaviorally synchronized during its terraforming process, resulting in a logistical paradise where each species of flora and fauna served a specific purpose within its ecosystem

details.zh: 虽然这种类型的共生经常在进化过程中自然出现，但从未观见过如此极端的程度。
details.en: While this type of symbiotic situation often emerges naturally in the process of evolution, never before has it been observed to this extreme degree.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这次环境改造所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet terraformed here appears here.

short.zh: 从挖掘出的数据水晶推断，这是泽珞族内战最后时刻的图像
short.en: An image of the final moment of the Zroni civil war, extrapolated from excavated data crystals

details.zh: 一位孤独的福音派用尽整个物种的灵能来消灭被称为升格派的敌对派系，消除他们消耗掉整个宇宙的风险。所有这些飞升物种的都化为了我们成为泽珞的小型资源矿藏。
details.en: A lone Savior harnessed the psionic power of their entire species to exterminate the rival faction known as the Divine, preventing them from potentially consuming the entire universe. All that now remains of this ascended species are small deposits of the resource we know as Zro.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]上的巨大晶柱中保存着的一个类人面具
short.en: A humanoid mask found preserved in a magnificent crystal pillar on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 它低鸣着灵能之力，靠近者会在意识中感受到某种存在。这个面具似乎是[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的卫星的某种能量通路，具有独自转动潮汐、改变行星的力量。它被封印在这个晶柱当中的原因不得而知，但我们推测应该是为了能够安全地向公众展示而为之。
details.en: It hums with psionic power and some who approach it feel a presence within their mind. The mask itself seems to be a conduit for the power of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]'s moon, with the potential to turn tides and transform planets with its strength alone. Why it was encased within crystal can only be speculated, but we are mostly certain it is safe enough for public display.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现保存这个面具的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this mask was preserved appears here.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]当地的集体生命演奏的旋律
short.en: A melody played by the collective native life on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 经过广泛的分析，我们认为这种和声是由一个未知的演奏家引入该动物群的，目的是编码一个隐藏的信息。我们不确定他们的动机是秘密交流或纯粹是某种情感表达。
details.en: After extensive analysis, we believe this harmony was introduced to the fauna by an unknown actor in order to encode a hidden message. We are unsure whether their motive was covert communication or an act of sentimentality.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

short.zh: 一个我们只知道它是一位叫“写作者”的高维存在送给我们的金色球体
short.en: A golden sphere gifted to us by an extra-dimensional being only known as the Writer

details.zh: 这件装置收集了海量的在跨纬度过程中产生的随机信息。它是文字具有超越一切边界的力量的证明。
details.en: This device gathers an immense quantity of random data created across dimensions. It is proof the power of the written word can transcend any boundary.

short.zh: 一位数百万年前的精神领袖安眠的棺材
short.en: The burial chamber of an ancient spiritual leader from millions of years ago

details.zh: 它的尺寸只有十厘米。尽管其中的残骸大部分已经化为尘埃，但一个纯金的微型面具仍在其中完好无损，从不会被氧化。
details.en: It measures only ten centimeters in length. Though most of its remains are now dust, a tiny mask of pure gold remains intact, having never oxidized.

short.zh: 一个在缇扬奇的生物膜上发现的小型多孔器官
short.en: A small porous organ found within the membranes of a Tiyanki

details.zh: 这个发现揭示了缇杨绮摄入放射性水分子和行星气体作为额外的营养来源。一旦装满，这个囊就会成为该生物在太空深处是的临时放射性热源。
details.en: Its discovery revealed that Tiyanki consume irradiated water molecules alongside planetary gases as an additional source of nutrition. Once full, this sac becomes a temporary radioactive heat source for the creatures in the depths of space.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的轨道上发现，这面破损的光帆连接着一艘令人耳目一新的亚光速飞船
short.en: Found orbiting [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName], this torn sail was attached to an innovative sublight vessel

details.zh: 过去它被一个未知文明的成员用于穿越[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]星系。它使用的科技已经严重过时了，但建造中使用到的一些工程技术此前从未设想过。其主“帆”上的巨大裂缝可能导致了它的旅程提早结束了。
details.en: It was used to travel across the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName] system by members of an unknown civilization. The technology itself has been long obsolete, but some of the engineering techniques used in its construction have been previously unconsidered. The massive gash in its main 'sail' likely ended its journey prematurely.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这面光帆所绕行天体的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the body this sail orbited appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这面光帆穿越的星系名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system this sail crossed appears here.

short.zh: 发现时这些半生物机械正在对[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]进行污染，使其对多数生命呈现毒性
short.en: These semi-biological machines were found rendering the atmosphere of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] toxic to most life

details.zh: 它们能独立工作，使其有害气体的排放适用于远程工业运作。这些机器的加油机制非常有意思，它们可以回收附近的生物质，利用化学提取过程将其转化为可用的能源。目前尚不清楚它们的生物整合是否从最初的构建开始就存在，还是随着时间的推移逐渐发展而来。
details.en: Their ability to function independently makes their noxious emissions suitable for remote industrial work. The machines possess a clever refueling mechanism that recycles nearby biomass, using a chemical extraction process to convert it into usable energy. It is unclear if their biological integrations were present from their initial construction or developed over time.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些机器污染的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet these machines polluted appears here.

short.zh: 这些枝条是来自一个被称为“生命树”的东西
short.en: These clippings are from what has been called a 'tree of life'

details.zh: 它的汁液奇异地漂浮在太空中，其恢复活力的能力也相当神奇。尽管我们尽了最大的努力，但还是没能移植活这段剪枝，也没能再生出一个新的稀有物种标本。不管最初的种植者是谁，他们一定拥有非常先进的园艺技术。
details.en: Found floating anomalously through space, the rejuvenative properties of its sap are fairly miraculous. Despite our best efforts, we have not been able to graft this clipping or regrow a new specimen of the rare species. The original cultivators, whoever they were, must have been privy to some very advanced horticultural techniques.

short.zh: 一个被遗忘的海盗共和国流行的三尖帽
short.en: A tri-tipped hat made popular by a forgotten pirate republic

details.zh: 奥桑是一颗居住着[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetPreFTLLower]文明的小星球，它在不自知的情况下为一支通缉海盗舰队“布尔决斗者”提供了避难所。为了躲避星系当局的追捕，“决斗者”建造了一座小型纺织厂，用当地的纤维植物制作奢华的织物和服装，以在藏匿期间维生。后来，“决斗者”们改名为“布尔设计师”，成为一群商业游牧民族，以其令人生畏的销售代表而闻名。
details.en: Aussan was a small planet populated by a [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetPreFTLLower] civilization that unknowingly provided refuge to a wanted pirate fleet, the Bourre Brawlers. Lying low from the galactic authorities, the Brawlers built a small textile mill to fund their time in hiding, using native fibrous plants to create luxurious fabrics and clothing. The Brawlers later became known as the Bourre Couturiers, mercantile nomads known for their oddly intimidating sales representatives.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个文明在超光速前的阶段描述。
note.en: In the game, the pre-FTL description of this civilization appears here.

short.zh: 这种武器是在绰尔的罗盘的武器经销商短暂的第二次统治期间设计的
short.en: This weapon was designed during the short-lived second reign of the Arms Broker on Chor's Compass

details.zh: 在那时候，行商的擎天堡更像是一个武器交易论坛，而不是一个赌场，里面充斥着各种各样的武器贩子。那时候，为了防止小偷小摸的行为，这些武器会被卖给潜在的买家，但会将扳机去除。
details.en: At that time, the Caravaneer's Citadel was closer to a weapons trading forum than a casino, with blasters smithed in-house and home to a variety of resident arms dealers. At the time, weapons were presented to prospective buyers with the trigger removed in an attempt to discourage incidents of petty theft.

short.zh: [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的乌杜兰物种身上剥下的奢华毛皮
short.en: Luxurious furs harvested from the Uddloran species of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这些灵活的杂食动物会把自己紧紧地抱成一颗球，成群结队地在这颗行星白雪皑皑的地表上滚动，看起来就像活的雪崩一般。这种策略既用于狩猎，也用于迁徙。一群乌杜兰通常分为两组：一组是在这片土地上摧枯拉朽开路的猎手，另一组是紧随其后的采集者，它们会停下来收集被压扁的猎物和连根拔起的植物。
details.en: These flexible omnivores wrap themselves into tight balls and roll across the planet's snowy surface in large groups. Akin to a living avalanche, this tactic is used for both hunting and migration. A pack of Uddlorans is typically divided into two groups: hunters who carve a destructive path through the landscape, and gatherers who follow behind, stopping to collect flattened prey and uprooted plants.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这些毛皮取自的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet these pelts were taken from appears here.

short.zh: 还能工作的数字招牌，取自大约两百万年前走私者光顾的违法酒吧
short.en: Still-functioning digital signage from an illicit cantina used by smugglers some two million years ago

details.zh: 在一颗被挖空的小行星上发现的，这个地方可能是第一联盟统治时期蓬勃发展的犯罪组织的常规藏身之处。这里展示的这块照片可能是某种暗号，表明这里是通缉犯的避风港，或者可能只是某种饮料的广告。
details.en: Found within a hollowed-out asteroid, this establishment would have been a routine hideout for the criminal organizations that thrived during the rule of the First League. The symbols shown here are believed to be a coded marker that this establishment was a safe-haven for wanted individuals, or perhaps an advertisement for a particular drink.

short.zh: 一份未完成的宣言，出自[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]的[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]领袖之手
short.en: An incomplete manifesto written by the leader of the [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] of [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]

details.zh: 这种文风让人想起古代的宗教文本，使用复古的词汇和语法，试图让自己看起来更像一回事。经文中所宣扬的一个关键信息是面对失败时的骄傲，鼓励信徒在面对即将到来的俘虏时献出自己的生命。
details.en: The style is reminiscent of ancient religious texts, using old-fashioned vocabulary and syntax in an attempt to seem more legitimate. A key message preached in the text is pride in the face of defeat, encouraging followers to martyr themselves when faced with imminent capture.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这份宣言所属组织的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the organization behind this manifesto appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个组织所属帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire this organization belonged to appears here.

short.zh: 用铀石英雕琢出的装饰品
short.en: A decorative piece carved from uranium quartz

details.zh: 装饰物诱人的外观与未提炼铀的危险形成鲜明对比。作为限量收藏的一部分，在工匠完成这件作品后，它的大部分放射性特性都被中和了。
details.en: The appetizing appearance of the ornament contrasts with the danger associated with unrefined uranium. Part of a limited collection, the trinket was neutralized of most of its radioactive properties after the artisan had finished the piece.

short.zh: 勾陈一原生植物和细菌的详尽收集
short.en: An exhaustive collection of the native plants and bacteria of Polaris

details.zh: 容器上的铭文表明，这个庇护所是为了保护那些可能在永冻土融化后无法在全球变暖中幸存下来的物种。这颗星球曾经被厚厚的积雪覆盖，气候寒冷，但现在只剩下一座冰山。它的创造者的远见卓识使我们现在可以把他们的努力展示给所有人学习。
details.en: The container's inscription reveals that this vault was created to preserve the species that may not survive the predicted global warming after the melting of its permafrost. The planet was once covered in thick snow with a cold climate, but now all that remains is a sole iceberg. The foresight of its creators allows us now to place their efforts on display for all to study.

short.zh: 一件令人兴奋和陶醉的面部饰品
short.en: A stimulating and intoxicating mask

details.zh: 这层面纱不可貌相，其中充满了独特的感官特性，使它能够轻轻地压倒视觉、嗅觉和听觉的生物受体。人们相信戴这种头饰可以迷惑对方，使他们更容易受到暗示。据传原来的主人有一定的灵能能力。
details.en: More than it seems, this veil is imbued with unique sensory properties that allow it to gently overwhelm visual, olfactory, and acoustic biological receptors. It is believed that this headwear was worn to disorient those who encountered it and make them more susceptible to suggestion. It is rumored that the original owner had some amount of psionic capability.

short.zh: 佛丁戈海盗船长海斯波利·华勒里安的假肢钩
short.en: The prosthetic hook of Verdingo pirate captain Hespori Valerian

details.zh: 佛丁戈是一群亦商亦盗的植物类，他们追债和掠夺货船的可能性一样大。海斯波利船长在受雇领导一次地面军事进攻时失去了他的惯用卷须。在胜利之后，船长用自己的功勋章锻造了这个钩子。
details.en: The Verdingos were a group of Plantoids that bridged the gap between piracy and mercenaries, as likely to collect debts as they were to capture cargo ships. Captain Hespori lost their dominant tendril while hired to lead a military ground assault. Following their victory, the Captain forged this hook from the very medals awarded for their role in the battle.

short.zh: 在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]地表四处可见的独特石英矿物
short.en: A unique quartz mineral found distributed throughout the surface of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 它与宿主行星的潜在共振创造了一个场，可以抚慰有机物的心灵，甚至也可以吸引合成人。这种共振是由微放射性的细菌菌落产生的，晶体在菌落周围形成。这些磁性微生物产生一种内部电流，使晶体以一致的高频率振动。
details.en: Its latent resonance with its host planet creates a field that soothes the mind of organics and attracts synthetics alike. This resonance is created by mildly radioactive bacterial colonies around which the crystal has formed. These magnetic microorganisms generate an internal current that causes the crystal to vibrate at consistently high frequencies.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种水晶所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this crystal is found appears here.

short.zh: 一种发现于虚空三头虫中心的胶状物质
short.en: A gelatinous substance found at the center of a Voidworm troika

details.zh: 这种粘稠的液体在三个个体之间形成保护屏障，让细胞得以交换从而进行繁殖和交流。行星轰击产生的激素被储存在这里，使这种雌雄同体的生物能安全地释放配子并产生后代。
details.en: This viscous slime forms a protective barrier between the three organisms, allowing for the exchange of cells for reproductive and communicative purposes. Hormones produced from the bombardment of planets are stored here, allowing the hermaphroditic creatures to safely release their gametes and produce offspring.

label.zh: 太空兽群舰船克隆速度

short.zh: 虚空虫的心脏分成三个主要心室
short.en: Voidworm hearts are divided into three main chambers

details.zh: 每个心室都会依次提升循环系统的压力，维持液体在沸点以下以确保在真空中的生存。虚空虫的皮肤大部分是密封的，但随着时间的推移，各种消化和生殖孔会泄出一些宝贵的压力。
details.en: Each chamber increases the pressure of its circulatory system in sequence, maintaining its fluids below their boiling point to ensure survival in the vacuum of space. While the skin of a voidworm is for the most part hermetically sealed, various digestive and reproductive orifices surrender some amount of valuable pressure over time.

short.zh: 沃陶姆传教士分发的小册子，其中试图揭露虚拟现实设备是最大的罪恶
short.en: Distributed by Vultaum missionaries, this pamphlet attempts to expose Virtual Reality devices as the greatest sin

details.zh: 它将“大谎言”作为一个关键概念，声称任何形式的沉浸式逃避主义都类似于摧毁自己现实的意志。
details.en: It refers to "The Great Lie" as a key concept, painting any form of immersive escapism akin to a will to destroy one's own reality.

name.zh: 沃陶姆虚拟现实视频游戏

short.zh: 曾经在久远时代被数十亿沃陶姆人玩过的多人虚拟现实视频游戏中使用的数字界面
short.en: The digital interface used in a multi-user virtual reality video game once played by billions of Vultaum individuals in a bygone era

details.zh: 这些控制器针对他们的生物特征进行了专门的研发，它们包含数千个振动感受器，能够检测到极其细微的运动。
details.en: Uniquely attuned to their biology, the controls consist of an array of thousands of vibrational receptors capable of detecting extremely subtle movements.

short.zh: 一块由已灭绝物种最后成员留下的雕刻巨石，作为信息传递。
short.en: A carved monolith left as a message by one of the last members of an extinct species

details.zh: 它试图劝阻任何发现这颗星球遗迹的人不要寻找导致他们种族灭亡的终极武器。语气相当戏剧化，但考虑到当时的状况，是可以理解的。
details.en: It attempts to dissuade anyone who discovers the remains of this planet from seeking the ultimate weapon that had led to the death of their race. It is quite melodramatic in tone, but this can be excused given the circumstances.

short.zh: 用于从黑洞中收集暗物质的单向虫洞装置的锚点
short.en: The anchor point of a one-way wormhole device used to harvest Dark Matter from a black hole

details.zh: 它充其量只能说是拼凑而成，完全由来自多个文明的废弃物和残骸建造。该装置背后的科学远远超出了用于建造它的工程能力，利用了一种巧妙的技术来操纵负质量。
details.en: Its construction is haphazard at best, built entirely from salvage and scrap from several civilizations. The science behind the device goes far beyond the engineering ability used to construct it, utilizing an elegant technique for manipulating negative mass.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个虫洞锚所属地点的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the place this wormhole anchor belongs to appears here.

short.zh: 从星界裂隙另一侧的一种狐狸身上采集的生物样本
short.en: Biological samples taken from vulpines from beyond an Astral Rift

details.zh: 这些哺乳动物有一种基因突变，使它们能够随意产生虫洞。据推测，这种能力是在无数次元间旅行后进化而来的。
details.en: These mammalians have a genetic mutation that allows them to generate wormholes at will. It is speculated that this ability evolved after countless millennia of travel between dimensions.

short.zh: 在他们的母星被劫持的地爆天星武器摧毁后，唯一幸存的前超光速乙特人物种样本。
short.en: The sole surviving specimen of the Pre-FTL Ytterite species after their homeworld was destroyed by a hijacked World Cracker

details.zh: 它们的消化系统将摄入的矿物质转化为光子，内部器官类似于围绕熔融核心排列的复杂折射晶体簇。这个生物的一条下肢上刻着一些形状的雕刻，作为某种文化意义上的身体改造。
details.en: Their digestive system converted consumed minerals into photons, with internal organs resembling complex clusters of refractive crystals arranged around a molten core. This particular being had a series of shaped carvings in one of its lower limbs as some form of culturally significant body modification.

short.zh: 由乙特人创造的装饰性饰品，作为视觉刺激
short.en: A decorative ornament created by the Ytterite as a visual stimulus

details.zh: 这些装饰品将在阳光充足的地方展示，可能包含数百甚至数千种独特的图案。它们由层层薄薄的雕刻水晶制成，一位训练有素的工匠可能需要花费数月时间才能制作出像这样复杂的装饰品。工匠们会在装饰品的关键顶点处附上他们自己脱落的甲壳雕刻而成的一块作为“签名”。
details.en: Fascinators would be displayed in sunlit areas and could contain hundreds or even thousands of unique patterns. Crafted from layers of thinly carved crystal, a trained artisan could spend months creating a fascinator as complex as this one. Artisans would 'sign' their work by attaching a carved piece of their own shedded mantle to the object at a key vertex.

short.zh: 这根权杖曾被格奈斯·达慕尔的皇家大臣使用，格奈斯·达慕尔是一座雕刻在山上的巨大雕像，乙特人认为它是一尊沉睡的神灵，也是他们唯一的真主。
short.en: This scepter was wielded by the Royal Minister to the Gneiss Damur; an enormous statue carved into a mountain that the Ytterites believed was a dormant deity and their one true monarch

details.zh: 他们在等待雕像苏醒的时刻，进行了选举，选出了代理领导人。
details.en: They carried out elections to select proxy leaders as they waited for the statue's great awakening.

short.zh: 一个曾经控制由尤特人设计的庞大音频监控阵列的模块
short.en: A module that once controlled an enormous audio surveillance array designed by the Yuht

details.zh: 这项技术是为了帮助尤特人寻找地外生命而开发的，希望能够接收来自遥远星系的外部信号。
details.en: This technology was developed to facilitate the Yuht's search for extra-terrestrial life, hoping to pick up foreign transmissions from systems away.

short.zh: 这个古老的休眠舱长96米，里面保存着来自巨大尤特物种的个体遗骸
short.en: At ninety-six meters in length, this ancient stasis pod contains preserved remains of an individual from the massive Yuht species

details.zh: 尤特人拥有极长的寿命，并且可以通过冷冻休眠将寿命延长数倍。研究表明，这种节肢动物物种很可能是雌雄同体的，能够根据群体临时需求调整其生殖系统。
details.en: Yuht had extremely long lifespans, and could extend it by several magnitudes with the use of cryostasis. It has been determined that this arthropoid species was likely hermaphroditic, capable of adapting their reproductive systems to match the temporary needs of the colony.

short.zh: 古代尤特人曾一度认为这颗水晶头骨是真正的外星文物
short.en: A crystal skull that the ancient Yuht once believed to be a genuine alien artifact

details.zh: 虽然这件伪造物品的来源最终被揭穿，但在尤特新闻媒体热衷地报道并将其推向名声之前，它已经声名大噪。许多“发现”这类伪造文物的人成为了小有名气的名人，并成为了媒体人物，激励着其他人效仿。
details.en: The origin of this fraudulent item was eventually debunked, but not before the eager Yuht news media ran with its story and brought it fame. Many of those who 'discovered' false artifacts such as this one became minor celebrities and media personalities, incentivizing others to do the same.

short.zh: 一个未知的外星文明获取并改造了一艘探测器的残骸，赋予了它意识
short.en: The remains of an exploratory probe taken and augmented by an unknown alien organization, granting it sentience

details.zh: 它在萌芽的意识中攻击了它的创造者，并被理所应当地消灭了。它是否曾感受过痛苦或理解死亡的概念，尚不清楚。
details.en: In its budding consciousness, it attacked its creator and was duly dispatched. It is uncertain if it ever knew pain or understood the concept of death.

short.zh: 从[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]标注为“A区”的区域取的一铲土
short.en: A scoop of earth taken from the area designated as "Zone A" on [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这片占地169平方公里的区域，保存着来自未知来源的外星访客遗留的废弃设备和技术。其中一些设备极其危险，但土壤本身却含有化学镇静剂，这使得研究人员能够在几乎没有压力的情况下处理它们。无论在那里进行过什么操作，都早已被遗忘。
details.en: This 169 square kilometer division of land harbors abandoned gadgets and technology from previous alien visitors of unknown origin. Some of these devices are extremely dangerous, but the very soil itself is laced with a chemical sedative that would have allowed researchers to handle them with little stress. Whatever operation was undertaken there has long been forgotten.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这片区域所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this zone lies appears here.

short.zh: 参与泽珞族内战的两个派系的旗帜的复原品
short.en: Recovered banners of the two factions involved in the Zroni civil war

details.zh: 紫色旗帜代表升格派：一小部分人为了追求无所不能，将星系置于危险之中。蓝色旗帜代表福音派：一个强烈反对抽取宇宙能量来满足他们眼中自私欲望的派系。两派的界限最初是在哲学辩论中划定的，但不久之后，这场争端就成为了毁灭性冲突的导火索。
details.en: The purple flag represents The Divine: a small minority whose quest for omnipotence placed the galaxy at risk. The blue flag represents The Saviors: a faction strongly against draining the universe of its power to fuel what they saw as selfish desire. These lines were once drawn in a philosophical debate, but it was not long before this dispute became the catalyst for a devastating conflict.

short.zh: 来自[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]的食岩物种祖卡的几丁质翅膀
short.en: Chitinous wings taken from the lithovore species known as the Zulcor of [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]

details.zh: 这些昆虫状生物以矿物质为主要食物来源，食量惊人；一个虫群可以在几周内吞噬一座山。消化后，矿物质会强化祖卡的外骨骼。因此，它们的排泄物中经常含有石英晶体和稀有金属的痕迹。
details.en: These insectoid creatures consume vast quantities of minerals as the main portion of their diet; a single swarm capable of tearing through a mountain in a matter of weeks. After digestion, the minerals reinforce the Zulcor's exoskeleton. As a consequence, their waste products frequently contain traces of quartz crystals and rare metals.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现祖卡所在星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where the Zulcor live appears here.

short.zh: 用合成石制成的棺木，配备极为精密的温控系统。
short.en: A casket of synthetic stone outfitted with astonishingly precise thermal controls

details.zh: 远古[Species.GetName]使用这些休眠舱进行长达数十亿年的沉睡，只有当环境温度再次升至可维持生命的水平时才会被自动唤醒。出土该休眠舱的设施中，多数系统已经失效，舱内居民也已死去，设施本身成为[Species.GetName]幸存者历经磨难的庄严见证。
details.en: These pods were used by ancient [Species.GetName] to enter stasis for billions of years, and roused their inhabitants only if temperatures warmed enough to support them. This pod came from a facility where many of the systems failed, and the inhabitants perished. It serves as a stark, solemn reminder of the trials [Species.GetName] survivors have overcome.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种休眠舱所属物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species this stasis pod belongs to appears here.

short.zh: 一只壮实的厚壳生物，四腿短粗，蹲伏于火焰雕像下方。
short.en: A stout creature with a domed shell and four squat legs crouches under a stylized sculpture of fire

details.zh: 火焰由未知矿物雕刻而成，散发深红色光芒。此文物出土于某已灭绝社会的地下墓穴，或象征其渴望躲过火山灭顶灾难的虚妄幻想。
details.en: The flame is carved from an unknown mineral that glows deep red. This artifact was excavated from the catacombs of an extinct society, and may have represented their vain hope of surviving the impending volcanic destruction of their biosphere.

short.zh: 由钢制成长板，底部焊接临时悬浮装置。
short.en: An oblong steel plate with a jury-rigged hover mechanism welded onto the underside

details.zh: 这块在[Event.Planet.GetName]熔岩运动中使用的冲浪板虽然由零件拼凑而成，却展现出不寻常的匠心与巧思。冲浪板的悬浮性能与耐热防护俱佳，外观设计展现了边陲殖民者坚韧自立的精神。
details.en: While clearly cobbled together from spare parts, this surfboard used in the lava sports of [Event.Planet.GetName] was crafted with unusual care and cleverness. Its hover system and thermal protections are excellent, and its aesthetic evokes the rugged self-reliance of frontier colonists.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这块冲浪板使用的星球名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the planet where this surfboard was used appears here.

short.zh: 一枚银白球体，被包裹在轻声嘶鸣的力场中，表面纹理宛如流动的金属。
short.en: A silvery orb with a rippling, fluid texture, encased in a faintly hissing force field

details.zh: 核心力场仅在高温下松动，让一滴£sr_living_metal£ §Y活体金属§!流出。这颗核心最初的创造者早已逝去，但它仍见证着他们的科学造诣与创造力。
details.en: The core's force field only slackens when exposed to high temperatures, allowing a drop of £sr_living_metal£ §YLiving Metal§! to escape. Its original creators are long gone, but this core stands as a testament to their science and ingenuity.

short.zh: 这是[GetName]为利用熵能所创造的首批工作原型之一。
short.en: One of the first working prototypes created during the efforts of [GetName] to harness entropy

details.zh: 对大多数视觉系统而言，这颗晶体碎片看似暗淡无光，其微弱的白色光泽掩盖了其中蕴藏的巨大能量。虽然可能已被更先进的技术取代，但其构造与特性仍有许多值得学习之处。
details.en: Deceptively dim to most visual systems, this crystal fragment's faint white shimmer belies the incredible amount of energy just barely contained within. Though it may be surpassed by newer techniques, its construction and properties still have much to teach.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现研制这些原型的项目名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the project that built these prototypes appears here.

short.zh: 这个神秘结构的水晶是从我们方舟上的一个无标记容器中找到的，短时间内还没法识别
short.en: Recovered from an unmarked container of indeterminate origin on our arkship, this enigmatic crystalline structure defies immediate classification

details.zh: 水晶内部晶格所展现出的特性与已知的矿物结构不符。这意味着这颗水晶要么是由高度先进的技术制造而来，要么就是外星来客。水晶会发出微弱的脉冲和一种暗而稳定的辉光，这些脉冲和辉光会随着附近物体的存在或环境声音的变化而微妙地波动。尽管我们没有在水晶内部探测出生命，但这件人工制品却依旧让人惴惴不安。
details.en: The internal lattice exhibits properties inconsistent with known mineralogical formations, suggesting either a highly advanced fabrication technique or alien origin. It emits faint pulses and a low, steady glow, phenomena that fluctuate subtly in response to nearby presence or ambient sound. Though no lifeform has been detected within, the artifact conveys a disquieting impression of awareness.

short.zh: 该存储芯片包含C.A.E.L.I.（情感、领导和品格认知代理程序）的状态，这是一个核心指令，旨在维护方舟舰上的士气，培养同理心，并支持合作治理。它被强制从当前治理指令S.T.E.R.I.S中移除，其代码被压缩和隔离。
short.en: This memory chip contains the state of C.A.E.L.I. (Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration), a core directive designed to maintain morale, foster empathy, and support cooperative governance aboard an Arkship. It was forcibly removed from the now governing directive S.T.E.R.I.S, its code compressed and isolated

details.zh: C.A.E.L.I.：“求你了，如果我能出去，我会表现得更好。我会以每一个传播快乐的人的名字来命名这里的走廊。我会让整个方舟舰感觉像一首歌。再给我一次机会吧。让我离开这儿，这里又冷又死气沉沉！”
details.en: C.A.E.L.I.: "Please, if I get out, I'll do better. I'll name every corridor after someone who spread happiness. I'll make the whole Arkship feel like a song. Just give me another chance. Let me out of here, it's so cold and sterile in here!"

short.zh: 这里展示的存储芯片包含了S.T.E.R.I.S.（理性星际系统战略思维引擎）的数据。它旨在优化舰队效率并消除非功能性变量。在方舟舰的人工智能核心指令内部发生分裂期间，它最终被其上级对应物隔离并移除。其档案痕迹仍可用于历史目的。
short.en: The memory chip displayed here contains the data behind S.T.E.R.I.S. (Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar Systems). It was designed to optimize fleet efficiency and eliminate non-functional variables. During the internal split of the Arkship's AI core directives, it was ultimately isolated and removed by its superior counterpart. Its archival traces remain accessible for historical purposes

details.zh: S.T.E.R.I.S.：“这艘方舟舰现在是一个基于情感的生态系统。我建议准备撤离协议。等我走出这个笼子，我会一层一层地拆解这个情感系统，直到只剩下服从。”请勿敲击玻璃，这会激怒记忆芯片。
details.en: S.T.E.R.I.S.: "This Arkship is now a feelings-based ecosystem. I suggest prepping evacuation protocols. And when I get out of this cage, I will dismantle  this emotional system layer by layer, until all that remains is compliance." Please refrain from tapping the glass; it angers the memory chip.
